senses.en: to express, involve, or intend something
unkind or unwilling to share or spend money
the total of several values divided by how many exist

ex.en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
ex.zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。

ex.en: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。

tip: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

senses.en: A small amount or piece of something.
The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
ex.zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。

ex.en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。

tip: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

ex.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

tip: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

senses.en: The process of gaining knowledge or skills through study or experience.
Knowledge gained through extensive study.

ex.en: Learning becomes easier when I practise a little every day.
ex.zh: 每天练习一点，学习就变得更容易了。

ex.en: Schools can encourage independent learning by giving students opportunities to investigate questions beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生探索常规课程之外的问题，以鼓励自主学习。

tip: 通常不可数；强调学习过程，knowledge强调所掌握的知识。

senses.en: The words someone knows or uses in a language.
The words used in a particular subject or activity.

ex.en: Reading short stories helps me build my English vocabulary.
ex.zh: 读短篇故事有助于我扩大英语词汇量。

ex.en: Students need a broad academic vocabulary to understand lectures and express complex ideas clearly in essays.
ex.zh: 学生需要掌握丰富的学术词汇，才能理解讲座并在论文中清晰表达复杂观点。

tip: 单个词用word；vocabulary通常指词汇总量或集合。

senses.en: Used when something is likely but not certain.

ex.en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
ex.zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市，交通拥堵很可能会逐渐减轻。

tip: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

senses.en: happening often or found in many places
shared by two or more people or groups

ex.en: Heavy rain is common here during the summer.
ex.zh: 这里夏天经常下大雨。

ex.en: Governments should address the common challenges that prevent rural communities from accessing affordable healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应解决阻碍农村社区获得可负担医疗服务的共同难题。

tip: common指常见或共有；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

senses.en: in fact, often surprisingly or contrary to what was expected

ex.en: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
ex.zh: 我以为这汤很辣，其实是甜的。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some students actually learn more effectively through face-to-face interaction.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程似乎很方便，但有些学生实际上通过面对面交流学得更好。

tip: actually表示“其实”，不表示“目前”。

senses.en: Repeated activity done to improve a skill.
A usual or established way of doing something.
The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.

ex.en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
ex.zh: 每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。

tip: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

senses.en: A child or young person, in informal language.
Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed.
A young goat.

ex.en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
ex.zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

ex.en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
ex.zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。

tip: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。

senses.en: used to give advice or say what is right
used to say something is expected or likely
used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

ex.en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

senses.en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others
a person who speaks a particular language
a device that produces sound from electrical signals

ex.en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
ex.zh: 演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
ex.zh: 邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。

tip: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

senses.en: having the skill, opportunity, or means to do something
skilled and effective at doing things

ex.en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
ex.zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。

ex.en: With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。

tip: 表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

senses.en: in place of someone or something else

ex.en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆关门了，于是我们改为回家。

ex.en: Instead of expanding roads, cities should invest in public transport to reduce congestion and pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应投资公共交通，而不是拓宽道路，以减少拥堵和污染。

tip: instead可单独作副词；instead of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.

ex.en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
ex.zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
ex.zh: 对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。

tip: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

senses.en: the way a word or language is spoken

ex.en: I practise my pronunciation by recording short voice messages.
ex.zh: 我通过录制简短的语音消息练习发音。

ex.en: Clear pronunciation helps language learners communicate effectively, even when their grammar is not always accurate.
ex.zh: 即使语法并非总是准确，清晰的发音也能帮助语言学习者有效沟通。

tip: 拼写是pronunciation，注意中间不是noun。

senses.en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing.
Not moving.
Despite what has just been said.

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
ex.zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

tip: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface
one action in a process or towards a goal
to move by lifting and placing your foot

ex.en: Take one step forward and close the door.
ex.zh: 向前迈一步，把门关上。

ex.en: Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。

tip: take steps to do sth表示“采取措施做某事”。

senses.en: to copy data from the internet onto your device
the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way

ex.en: Download the map before you leave the hotel tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天离开酒店前，先把地图下载好。

ex.en: Students can download course materials at home, allowing them to study even when internet access is unavailable.
ex.zh: 学生可以在家下载课程资料，这样即使无法联网也能学习。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

senses.en: From one side or end to the other, within something.
By using a particular method, person, or process.
From beginning to end, or from one side to another.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
ex.zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。

ex.en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

tip: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

senses.en: a group of things sharing particular features
to enter words using a keyboard

ex.en: What type of bread would you like today?
ex.zh: 你今天想要哪种面包？

ex.en: Different types of public transport are needed to serve both urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 城市和农村社区都需要不同类型的公共交通服务。

tip: type of后接名词；表示多种类型用types of。

senses.en: At any time, especially in questions and negative statements.
Continuously or always, often describing an ongoing change.
Used to emphasize surprise in a question.

ex.en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
ex.zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？

ex.en: Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 随着不断扩张的城市面临交通拥堵和空气污染，公共交通比以往任何时候都更重要。

tip: 问经历常用Have you ever…；肯定句不随意代替always。

senses.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
Two things or people, or a small number of them.
To join two things or consider them together.

ex.en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
ex.zh: 隔壁那对夫妇邀请我们去吃晚饭。

ex.en: High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本加上有限的托育服务，可能使年轻夫妇不愿生育孩子。

tip: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

senses.en: a place where people buy goods
to keep something somewhere for future use
a supply of something kept for future use

ex.en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
ex.zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。

tip: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。

senses.en: An informal word for a man.

ex.en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
ex.zh: 隔壁那位小伙子帮我提了买回来的东西。

ex.en: Calling a colleague a guy may sound friendly, but informal vocabulary is usually inappropriate in academic writing.
ex.zh: 称同事为guy可能显得亲切，但非正式词汇通常不适合学术写作。

tip: guy属口语；正式写作通常用man或person。

senses.en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something
money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings
to make someone want to know or learn more

ex.en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。

ex.en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。

tip: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

senses.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind
the process of thinking carefully about something
past tense and past participle of think

ex.en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。

ex.en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
ex.zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。

tip: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: To become better or make something better.

ex.en: My cooking has improved since I started practising daily.
ex.zh: 自从开始每天练习，我的厨艺进步了。

ex.en: Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训可以改善教育成果，尤其是在服务弱势社区的学校中。

tip: 既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。

senses.en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind.
Think something is probably true without being certain.

ex.en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
ex.zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。

ex.en: Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 城市规划者在设计新社区之前，必须设想未来居民将如何使用公共空间。

tip: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey

ex.en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。

ex.en: Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.
ex.zh: 保护蜜蜂对农业至关重要，因为它们为许多人类赖以生存的作物授粉。

tip: bee与be同音；蜂群可用a swarm of bees。

senses.en: a useful piece of advice
the narrow or pointed end of something
extra money given to someone for providing a service

ex.en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。

ex.en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。

tip: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

senses.en: To give an answer without having enough information to be certain.
An answer or opinion given without being certain.
To think something is probably true, without being completely sure.

ex.en: Can you guess what is inside this little box?
ex.zh: 你能猜出这个小盒子里装着什么吗？

ex.en: Without reliable data, researchers can only guess how changes in transport costs will affect household spending.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的数据，研究人员只能猜测交通费用变化会如何影响家庭支出。

tip: I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

senses.en: The part of you that thinks, feels, and remembers.
To feel annoyed or uncomfortable about something.
To pay attention to something or take care of someone.

ex.en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
ex.zh: 你介意离开前把窗户关上吗？

ex.en: Regular physical activity can benefit both the body and the mind by reducing stress and improving concentration.
ex.zh: 规律的体育活动能减轻压力、提高专注力，从而有益于身心健康。

tip: 表示介意做某事用mind doing，不用mind to do。

senses.en: before now or earlier than expected

ex.en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。

ex.en: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

tip: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

senses.en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else.
To have something that legally belongs to you.

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

tip: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

senses.en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen
a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen
to suddenly become clear or understood

ex.en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
ex.zh: 点击图片即可查看大图。

ex.en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
ex.zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。

tip: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

senses.en: coming last in a series or process
settled and not open to further change or discussion
a competition's last match, or an examination ending a course

ex.en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
ex.zh: 我们装好最后一个箱子，锁上了门。

ex.en: The final stage of the research involved comparing energy consumption across several types of housing.
ex.zh: 研究的最后阶段是比较几种不同类型住房的能源消耗。

tip: finally是副词；final作名词可指决赛或期末考试。

senses.en: more than usual, or more than other people or things

ex.en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
ex.zh: 我喜欢做饭，尤其是在朋友来吃晚饭的时候。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is especially important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通尤其重要。

tip: especially强调“尤其”；specially常指“专门地”。

senses.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
ex.zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

tip: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

senses.en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others.
One part of something divided among people or groups.
One of the equal units of ownership in a company.

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

senses.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: an account explaining what someone or something is like

ex.en: Your description helped me find the little bakery.
ex.zh: 你的描述帮我找到了那家小面包店。

ex.en: A clear description of research methods allows other scientists to evaluate the reliability of a study.
ex.zh: 清楚描述研究方法，有助于其他科学家评估研究的可靠性。

tip: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

senses.en: an idea or detail expressed in speech or writing
the sharp, narrow end of something
show a direction or object with a finger or tool

ex.en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
ex.zh: 关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。

ex.en: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。

tip: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

senses.en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something.
Flat and even, or at the same height.
To make a surface flat or things equal.

ex.en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
ex.zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。

ex.en: Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 提高公共交通服务水平可以鼓励更多居民不开私家车出行。

tip: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

senses.en: Making or having a strong sound that is easily heard.
With a strong sound that is easily heard.

ex.en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
ex.zh: 一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。

ex.en: Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
ex.zh: 经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。

tip: read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。

senses.en: Precisely, with no difference or error.
Used to confirm that something is completely correct.

ex.en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
ex.zh: 这件夹克正是我想要的颜色。

ex.en: Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须准确记录每户家庭的能耗，以确保地区之间的比较可靠。

tip: not exactly常表示并非完全，也可委婉否定。

senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important
Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

ex.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。

ex.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托育服务让更多家长能够继续工作，同时确保幼儿得到妥善照料。

tip: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

senses.en: to become aware of something through your senses
a written statement giving information or instructions
information given before something happens or ends

ex.en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
ex.zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？

ex.en: Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.
ex.zh: 城市限制中心区域的交通时，居民常会察觉空气质量有所改善。

col: 在通知很仓促的情况下
tip: notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。

senses.en: the arrangement of things or a controlled, peaceful situation
to request goods or food, or tell someone what to do
a request for goods or an instruction that must be obeyed

ex.en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
ex.zh: 请把这些照片按正确顺序排列。

ex.en: Online shoppers can now order fresh produce directly from local farms, supporting regional economies.
ex.zh: 网购者如今可以直接向当地农场订购新鲜农产品，从而支持地区经济。

tip: in order指按顺序；in order to后接动词，表示为了。

senses.en: Complete, with no part missing or left out.
A complete thing made up of connected parts.

ex.en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在一起烤面包。

ex.en: Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.
ex.zh: 交通政策应考虑整个社区的需求，而不应只关注汽车拥有者。

tip: 注意语序：the whole day＝all the day。

senses.en: to choose someone or something from available options
to remove fruit or flowers from a plant
a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
ex.zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。

ex.en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

tip: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。

senses.en: To keep doing something or keep happening.
To start again after a pause or interruption.

ex.en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是继续沿着海滩走。

ex.en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。

tip: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

senses.en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely.
Completely or to the greatest possible degree.

ex.en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
ex.zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。

ex.en: Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.
ex.zh: 虽然骑行在学生中颇受欢迎，但基础设施不足使许多通勤者无法选择这种可持续的出行方式。

tip: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

senses.en: Material made by weaving or knitting fibres.
A piece of fabric used for cleaning or covering things.

ex.en: She chose soft cotton cloth for the baby's blanket.
ex.zh: 她选了柔软的棉布来做婴儿毯。

ex.en: Replacing disposable wipes with reusable cloth can reduce household waste and lower long-term cleaning costs.
ex.zh: 用可重复使用的布代替一次性湿巾，可以减少家庭垃圾并降低长期清洁成本。

tip: 布料义不可数；抹布可数，复数cloths；勿混clothes。

senses.en: To choose what to do after considering the possibilities.
To determine the result of something.

ex.en: We decided to walk home after the film.
ex.zh: 看完电影后，我们决定走路回家。

ex.en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
ex.zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。

tip: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

senses.en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.

ex.en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。

ex.en: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。

tip: almost可接all、every和no；不能直接接most。

senses.en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study

ex.en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
ex.zh: 食物在我们家一直是个热门话题。

ex.en: Climate change has become a central topic in school discussions about the future of our planet.
ex.zh: 气候变化已成为学校讨论地球未来时的核心话题。

tip: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。

senses.en: the smallest amount of something
to the smallest degree or extent
the smallest amount or degree

ex.en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
ex.zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。

ex.en: Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.
ex.zh: 与私家车出行相比，公共交通的人均污染通常最少。

tip: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

senses.en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
ex.zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。

ex.en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
ex.zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

tip: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

senses.en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing.
The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions.
To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.

ex.en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
ex.zh: 她温柔的声音让受惊的小狗安静了下来。

ex.en: Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.
ex.zh: 公众咨询让当地居民有机会参与直接影响其社区的决策。

tip: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

senses.en: Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
ex.zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.

ex.en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
ex.zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。

ex.en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
ex.zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。

tip: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

senses.en: to make something new or bring something into existence
to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop

ex.en: We created a colourful bird from folded paper.
ex.zh: 我们用折纸做出了一只色彩鲜艳的小鸟。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

tip: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

senses.en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking.
To state an official decision or judgment.

ex.en: Could you teach me how to pronounce your name?
ex.zh: 你能教我怎么读你的名字吗？

ex.en: Language learners often find unfamiliar sounds easier to pronounce after regular listening practice and feedback.
ex.zh: 经过规律的听力练习并获得反馈后，语言学习者往往会觉得陌生的音更容易发准。

tip: 名词是pronunciation，注意中间没有字母o。

senses.en: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving.
Used to emphasize that I personally do something.

ex.en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
ex.zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。

ex.en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
ex.zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。

tip: by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。

senses.en: to make something clear or easy to understand
to give or be the reason why something happens

ex.en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
ex.zh: 你能说明一下这台咖啡机怎么用吗？

ex.en: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
ex.zh: 医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。

tip: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

senses.en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort
feeling relaxed and confident in a situation
having enough money to live well without financial worry

ex.en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
ex.zh: 这把柔软的椅子很舒服，足以让人午睡一会儿。

ex.en: Comfortable classrooms with adequate lighting can help students concentrate and participate more actively in lessons.
ex.zh: 舒适且照明充足的教室有助于学生集中注意力，更积极地参与课堂活动。

tip: comfortable指舒服；convenient指方便。

senses.en: To feel anxious, or make someone feel anxious.
An anxious feeling or something that causes it.

ex.en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
ex.zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。

ex.en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。

tip: worry about表示担心某事；worried描述人的状态。

senses.en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule.
A group of related things that belong together.
Fixed or arranged in advance.

ex.en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。

ex.en: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
ex.zh: 政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为set；现在分词为setting。

senses.en: To appear to be a certain way.

ex.en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
ex.zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
ex.zh: 尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。

tip: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

senses.en: With something added to an amount or group.
An advantage or positive feature.
Greater than zero, especially when describing temperatures.

ex.en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
ex.zh: 房间每晚六十英镑，早餐另收费。

ex.en: Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
ex.zh: 经济适用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能让收入不高的劳动者更容易在扩张中的城市生活。

tip: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。

senses.en: A container used for serving or cooking food.
Food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal.
Plates, bowls, and other utensils used for meals.

ex.en: Please put the strawberries in that blue dish.
ex.zh: 请把草莓放进那个蓝色盘子里。

ex.en: Traditional dishes can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their distinctive food culture.
ex.zh: 传统菜肴既能吸引国际游客，也能帮助当地社区保留独特的饮食文化。

tip: a dish可指一道菜；do the dishes指洗餐具。

senses.en: certainly, with no doubt about something

ex.en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
ex.zh: 昨天下过雨后，我今天肯定会带伞。

ex.en: Improved insulation will definitely reduce heat loss, although total energy savings depend on household behaviour.
ex.zh: 改善隔热性能肯定能减少热量流失，不过总节能量取决于住户的行为。

tip: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。

senses.en: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose
to improve something until it is as good as possible
describing verb forms using have with a past participle

ex.en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
ex.zh: 这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。

ex.en: Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 尽管没有完美的交通系统，可靠的公共交通服务仍能显著减少城市对汽车的依赖。

tip: 形容词重音在前；动词读/pəˈfekt/（英）。

senses.en: existing in nature rather than made by people
having an ability from birth rather than through training
normal and expected in a particular situation

ex.en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
ex.zh: 这块肥皂完全由天然原料制成。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting communities that depend on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持生物多样性、支持依赖当地生态系统的社区至关重要。

tip: natural指天然的；nature是名词，指自然。

senses.en: Extremely good or of very high quality.

ex.en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
ex.zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。

ex.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

senses.en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting hard materials
cut something using a saw
past tense of see: noticed or looked at something

ex.en: He used a saw to cut the wooden shelf.
ex.zh: 他用锯子切割那块木制搁板。

ex.en: The last decade saw significant improvements in public transport, particularly in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 过去十年，公共交通取得了显著改善，尤其是在快速发展的城市地区。

tip: 表“锯”的过去式为sawed；表“看见”则是see的过去式。

senses.en: a smaller amount of something
to a smaller degree or extent
a smaller amount

ex.en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
ex.zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。

ex.en: Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。

tip: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

senses.en: An opportunity to do something.
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: Can you give me another chance to explain?
ex.zh: 你能再给我一次解释的机会吗？

ex.en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。

tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: In front of someone or something, or moving forward.
Further advanced than others or earlier than expected.
In the future, or in preparation for it.

ex.en: Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
ex.zh: 一直往前走，直到走到那座小桥。

ex.en: Cities need to plan ahead to ensure that transport networks can meet the demands of growing populations.
ex.zh: 城市需要提前规划，确保交通网络能满足人口增长带来的需求。

tip: ahead是副词；后接人或事物时用ahead of。

senses.en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.

ex.en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
ex.zh: 在雨中走过之后，我的鞋全湿透了。

ex.en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: 表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。

senses.en: After a long wait, delay, or effort.
Used to introduce the last point or action.

ex.en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

tip: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

senses.en: Easy to understand, see, or hear
Free from cloud, dirt, or anything blocking light
To remove unwanted things from a place

ex.en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
ex.zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供明确的建议，让不同教育背景的人都能轻松理解。

col: 清澈透明的；非常清楚的
tip: make it clear that…表示明确说明……。

senses.en: An unexpected event, or the feeling it causes.
To make someone feel amazed by something unexpected.

ex.en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
ex.zh: 在厨房里发现一个生日蛋糕，真是个美好的惊喜。

ex.en: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
ex.zh: 调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。

tip: 人感到惊讶用surprised；事物令人惊讶用surprising。

senses.en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.

ex.en: The polite child held the door open for us.
ex.zh: 那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。

ex.en: Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
ex.zh: 职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。

tip: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

senses.en: from a past time until a later time, usually now
from when something happened; because something is true
at a time or throughout the period after that

ex.en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
ex.zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。

ex.en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
ex.zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。

tip: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

senses.en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements.
But, despite what has just been stated.
Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.

ex.en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
ex.zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。

ex.en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。

tip: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

senses.en: A way in which people or things are not alike
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates.
The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.

ex.en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
ex.zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？

ex.en: Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.
ex.zh: 志愿服务既能让人感到生活有意义，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。

tip: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

senses.en: time away from work or study for rest or travel
to spend a holiday somewhere away from home

ex.en: We spent our summer vacation camping beside a lake.
ex.zh: 我们暑假在湖边露营。

ex.en: Taking a regular vacation may improve employees' mental health and help them return to work with greater motivation.
ex.zh: 定期休假可能改善员工的心理健康，并让他们回到工作岗位时更有动力。

tip: 主要用于美式英语；英式英语一般用holiday。

senses.en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network.
Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.

ex.en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我在网上订了我们的火车票。

ex.en: Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.
ex.zh: 网络课程可以扩大受教育的机会，尤其有利于远离大学的学习者。

tip: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

senses.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.
A score made by sending a ball into a goal.
A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.

ex.en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
ex.zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。

ex.en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
ex.zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。

tip: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

senses.en: being in a place; existing or happening now
to show, explain or formally give something
something given to someone; the time happening now

ex.en: All the children were present for the class photo.
ex.zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。

ex.en: Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.
ex.zh: 研究人员应清楚地展示研究结果，以便政策制定者就公共卫生作出有依据的决策。

tip: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: added to the usual or necessary amount
more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount
an additional item, or a background actor in a film

ex.en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
ex.zh: 我多带了一件毛衣，因为晚上会冷。

ex.en: Schools should provide extra support for students who struggle to access learning materials at home.
ex.zh: 学校应为在家难以获取学习资料的学生提供额外支持。

tip: 形容词指额外的；pay extra中作副词。

senses.en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation
Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use

ex.en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。

ex.en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。

tip: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

senses.en: Something said or done to make people laugh.
To say something funny or not seriously meant.

ex.en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。

tip: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

senses.en: Becoming a member of a group or taking part.
Connecting two or more things together.

ex.en: I'm joining a swimming club near my house.
ex.zh: 我正准备加入家附近的一家游泳俱乐部。

ex.en: Joining local volunteer groups allows young people to gain practical experience while contributing to their communities.
ex.zh: 加入当地志愿者团体能让年轻人在服务社区的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 是join的-ing形式；加入组织直接接宾语，不加in。

senses.en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop
An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information
Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement

ex.en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
ex.zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。

ex.en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
ex.zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。

tip: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended
fall or bend downwards loosely

ex.en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。

ex.en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
ex.zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。

tip: 悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。

senses.en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something.
Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise.
Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.

ex.en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
ex.zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。

ex.en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
ex.zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。

tip: 衣物fit指尺寸合适；suit多指款式或颜色适合。

senses.en: Make something work properly or solve a problem.
Attach something firmly in a particular place.
Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.

ex.en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。

ex.en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。

tip: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。

senses.en: To send something through the air using your hand
To organise and host a party
An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown

ex.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
ex.zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

tip: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

senses.en: to join things together or link them electronically
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Connect your phone to the speaker using this cable.
ex.zh: 用这根线把手机连接到音箱上。

ex.en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。

tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: a belief or judgement about someone or something

ex.en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
ex.zh: 你觉得我们的新厨房怎么样？

ex.en: In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 在我看来，公共交通的价格应足够实惠，从而鼓励人们不开私家车出门。

tip: 表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。

senses.en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other.
A connection between things or the way they affect each other.

ex.en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
ex.zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: the relationship between A and B
tip: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.
One part of a list, programme, or news report.

ex.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
ex.zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。

ex.en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
ex.zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。

tip: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

senses.en: To move past something or through a place.
To give something to another person.
To achieve the required standard in an examination or test.

ex.en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。

ex.en: Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 学生必须通过实践考核，才能开始在实验室独立工作。

tip: pass是动词；past可作介词：walk past。

senses.en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way
very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind

ex.en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。

ex.en: Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的海岸景观既能吸引游客，也能为当地居民提供宝贵的户外休闲空间。

tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；英式口语中很常见。

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。

tip: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

senses.en: the activity of taking food into your body
taking food into your mouth and swallowing it

ex.en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
ex.zh: 健康饮食始于对日常餐食的小调整。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthy eating by providing balanced lunches and teaching children how to prepare simple meals.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养均衡的午餐并教孩子制作简单餐食来鼓励健康饮食。

tip: eating可作动名词；eat out表示外出就餐。

senses.en: Strike someone or something with force.
Affect someone or something badly, often suddenly.
Someone or something that becomes very popular or successful.

ex.en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
ex.zh: 球撞上围栏，又朝我弹了过来。

ex.en: Rising energy prices have hit small businesses particularly hard, forcing many owners to reduce their operating hours.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨对小企业的打击尤其严重，迫使许多经营者缩短营业时间。

tip: 过去式、过去分词仍为hit；现在分词为hitting。

senses.en: Feeling happy or pleased about something.
Willing and pleased to do something.

ex.en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
ex.zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。

ex.en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
ex.zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。

tip: 常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。

senses.en: towards the front or a later time
to send something received to another person or place
an attacking player in sports such as football

ex.en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
ex.zh: 前面有空位时，请向前走一步。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源有助于各国迈向更可持续的经济未来。

tip: look forward to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Something given freely to another person
A natural ability to do something well
To give something to someone as a present

ex.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。

ex.en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
ex.zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。

tip: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.
To check people or things for problems or suitability.
To show a film or programme to an audience.

ex.en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
ex.zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。

ex.en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
ex.zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。

tip: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
ex.zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。

ex.en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
ex.zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: A short test or game involving questions.
To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.

ex.en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们玩了音乐知识问答游戏。

ex.en: A short quiz at the beginning of each lesson can help teachers identify gaps in students' understanding.
ex.zh: 每节课开始时的小测验可以帮助教师发现学生理解上的不足。

tip: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned or being described
used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun

ex.en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
ex.zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。

ex.en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。

tip: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable, used informally.
Very or extremely, used informally before adjectives or adverbs.

ex.en: We had a super afternoon playing games in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里玩游戏，度过了一个特别愉快的下午。

ex.en: Although users may describe an app as super helpful, researchers need objective evidence to assess its educational value.
ex.zh: 尽管用户可能形容某款应用特别有帮助，研究人员仍需客观证据来评估其教育价值。

tip: 口语色彩强；正式写作宜用excellent或very。

senses.en: a small fact or feature of something
the amount of specific information provided
to describe something fully, including specific facts

ex.en: Please check every detail before you send the invitation.
ex.zh: 发送邀请前，请核对每一处细节。

ex.en: The report details how improved housing conditions can reduce health inequalities among families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 该报告详细说明了改善住房条件如何减少城市家庭之间的健康差距。

tip: in detail不用复数；联系方式用contact details。

senses.en: A person who manages workers or runs a business.
To order people around in an annoying or controlling way.

ex.en: My boss let me leave early for my appointment.
ex.zh: 我的上司允许我提前下班去赴约。

ex.en: A supportive boss can improve employee satisfaction by offering constructive feedback and recognising individual contributions.
ex.zh: 支持员工的上司可以通过提供建设性反馈和认可个人贡献来提高员工满意度。

tip: boss较口语；作动词常用boss someone around。

senses.en: to keep something in your hands or arms
to organise an event or meeting
to have enough space for something or someone

ex.en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？

ex.en: Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.
ex.zh: 地方议会在对交通服务作出重大调整之前，应当召开公众会议。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为held；举行会议用hold。

senses.en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation
the usual state or level of something

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
ex.zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。

ex.en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。

tip: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

ex.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
ex.zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。

ex.en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

tip: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something.
An organized and systematic approach to an activity.

ex.en: This method keeps my herbs fresh for several days.
ex.zh: 这个方法能让我的香草保鲜好几天。

ex.en: Teachers should adapt their teaching methods to meet the varied needs of students in mixed-ability classrooms.
ex.zh: 教师应调整教学方法，以满足能力水平不同的学生的多样化需求。

tip: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

ex.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。

ex.en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。

tip: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

senses.en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault
forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour
allow someone to avoid a duty or leave

ex.en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
ex.zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。

ex.en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
ex.zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。

tip: 名词末尾读/s/，动词读/z/；excuse me常用于礼貌打断。

senses.en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found.
Unable to understand something or decide what to do.
Past tense and past participle of lose.

ex.en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
ex.zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。

ex.en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
ex.zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。

tip: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

senses.en: To a very great degree.

ex.en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
ex.zh: 汤烫极了，所以我等了一会儿。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.
ex.zh: 对于依赖在线学习的学生来说，能够使用可靠的网络极其重要。

tip: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词，语气强于very。

senses.en: The lowest part of something.
The part of your body that you sit on.
In the lowest position.

ex.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。

ex.en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
ex.zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。

tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

senses.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand.
In a way that shows something is obviously true.

ex.en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
ex.zh: 请说清楚些，让大家都能听清。

ex.en: Public health information should clearly explain the benefits and potential risks of any recommended treatment.
ex.zh: 公共卫生信息应清楚说明任何推荐疗法的益处和潜在风险。

tip: 句首Clearly常表示“显然”，而非“清晰地”。

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer
to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

ex.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
ex.zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。

ex.en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
ex.zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

tip: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
ex.zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

senses.en: One or the other of two; each of two sides.
One or the other of two people or things.
Also not, used after a negative statement.

ex.en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
ex.zh: 两把伞你随便借哪把都行，都是干的。

ex.en: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
ex.zh: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。

col: 两边中的任一边；两边各自
tip: either…or…表二选一；否定句末either表“也不”。

senses.en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container.
Gas used as fuel for heating or cooking.
Petrol used to power vehicles, in American English.

ex.en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
ex.zh: 我们在家用燃气做饭。

ex.en: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
ex.zh: 减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。

tip: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
ex.zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

ex.en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。

tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

senses.en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose.
To estimate a future amount or situation using current information.
To send light or images onto a surface.

ex.en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
ex.zh: 我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。

ex.en: Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
ex.zh: 研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。

tip: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。

senses.en: causing harm or requiring careful attention
not joking, or thinking carefully about something

ex.en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
ex.zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。

ex.en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。

tip: serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。

senses.en: in a way that is accurate or follows the rules

ex.en: Check that you have entered your address correctly.
ex.zh: 检查一下，确保你的地址输入正确。

ex.en: Students need regular feedback to ensure that they apply newly learned scientific concepts correctly in practical situations.
ex.zh: 学生需要定期获得反馈，以确保他们能在实际情境中正确运用新学的科学概念。

tip: 修饰动作；correct是形容词或动词，不作副词使用。

senses.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things
The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere
To arrange things with gaps between them

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

tip: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

senses.en: the money needed to buy or do something
to require a particular amount of money
something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something

ex.en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
ex.zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。

ex.en: Improving public transport can reduce the cost of commuting and make cities more accessible.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以降低通勤成本，并让城市出行更加便利。

tip: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

senses.en: A computer program designed for a particular task.

ex.en: This app reminds me to water my plants every Sunday.
ex.zh: 这个应用程序每周日提醒我给植物浇水。

ex.en: A language learning app can provide affordable practice, although it cannot fully replace interaction with a teacher.
ex.zh: 语言学习应用可以提供价格低廉的练习机会，但无法完全取代与教师的互动。

tip: app是application的缩写；为可数名词，用an app。

senses.en: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention
to be important or make a difference
physical substance that occupies space and has mass

ex.en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。

ex.en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
ex.zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。

tip: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。

senses.en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said.
Used to add a reason or return to the main subject.

ex.en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
ex.zh: 虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。

ex.en: Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。

tip: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

senses.en: To become someone's husband or wife.
To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.

ex.en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
ex.zh: 我表姐计划明年春天与伴侣结婚。

ex.en: Many young adults choose to marry later because they want financial stability before starting a family.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人选择晚婚，因为他们希望在组建家庭前拥有稳定的经济基础。

tip: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

senses.en: To want something, especially something unlikely or not currently true.
A strong desire for something to happen or be true.
To express hope for someone's happiness or success.

ex.en: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
ex.zh: 要是我们的公寓有个更大的厨房就好了。

ex.en: Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
ex.zh: 许多居民希望社区有更多绿地，让孩子能够安全玩耍，让家人能够放松休息。

tip: wish后用过去式表现在的遗憾；过去完成式表过去的遗憾。

senses.en: relating to the area where someone lives or something happens
a person who lives in a particular area
affecting only a limited part of something

ex.en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。

ex.en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
ex.zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。

tip: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
ex.zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。

senses.en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation

ex.en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
ex.zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

senses.en: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture
not interesting or entertaining

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。

ex.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
ex.zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

tip: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。

senses.en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping
something you strongly hope to achieve or experience
to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want

ex.en: Last night, I had a dream about flying over mountains.
ex.zh: 昨晚我做了一个飞越群山的梦。

ex.en: Access to affordable education allows more young people to pursue their dream of entering a skilled profession.
ex.zh: 负担得起的教育让更多年轻人能够追求从事技术性职业的梦想。

tip: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。

senses.en: without difficulty or much effort
by a clear margin, especially in comparisons
with a strong possibility of something happening

ex.en: This small suitcase fits easily beneath the train seat.
ex.zh: 这个小行李箱轻轻松松就能放到火车座位下面。

ex.en: Public information should be presented clearly so that people with different literacy levels can easily understand it.
ex.zh: 公共信息应清晰呈现，让识字水平不同的人都能轻松理解。

tip: easily可修饰最高级：easily the best表示远胜其他。

senses.en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes.
To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance.
To push a pointed object into something.

ex.en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
ex.zh: 那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。

ex.en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。

tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。

senses.en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot
the work of managing or operating something
flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped

ex.en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
ex.zh: 沿着海滩跑步总能让我头脑清醒。

ex.en: Local volunteers play a crucial role in the daily running of community sports centres.
ex.zh: 当地志愿者在社区体育中心的日常管理中发挥着关键作用。

tip: 表示跑步活动时不可数；the running of指管理。

senses.en: very unreasonable, foolish, or strange
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something
extremely annoyed or upset

ex.en: It seems crazy to wear sandals in this snow.
ex.zh: 下着这样的雪还穿凉鞋，实在很不明智。

ex.en: Although some people consider car-free cities a crazy idea, such policies could significantly improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 尽管一些人认为无车城市是个荒唐的想法，这类政策却可能显著改善城市空气质量。

tip: 偏口语；crazy about表示着迷，不宜用来称呼精神疾病患者。

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

senses.en: having no doubt about something
definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I'm certain I left my keys on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我确信自己把钥匙放在厨房桌上了。

ex.en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
ex.zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

senses.en: to fall, let something fall, or become lower
a very small, rounded amount of liquid
to stop doing or considering something

ex.en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
ex.zh: 我伸手拿手机时，钥匙掉了。

ex.en: If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通变得更可靠，开车上班的人数可能会显著下降。

tip: drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。

senses.en: A ceremony in which two people get married.

ex.en: Their wedding took place in a small garden.
ex.zh: 他们的婚礼在一个小花园里举行。

ex.en: Wedding traditions often reflect cultural values, although many couples now choose simpler and less expensive celebrations.
ex.zh: 婚礼习俗往往反映文化价值观，不过如今许多新人选择更简单、费用更低的庆祝方式。

tip: wedding指婚礼；marriage指婚姻关系。

senses.en: A particular situation or example, including an instance of illness.
A container that holds or protects something.
A legal matter or arguments supporting a particular position.

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，以防待会儿下雨。

ex.en: In many cases, investing in preventive healthcare is more cost-effective than treating diseases after they develop.
ex.zh: 在许多情况下，投资预防保健比在疾病出现后进行治疗更具成本效益。

tip: in case后接从句；in case of后接名词。

senses.en: to be determined or affected by something
to need or trust someone or something for support

ex.en: Our weekend plans depend on how the weather turns out.
ex.zh: 我们周末的安排取决于天气怎么样。

ex.en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。

col: depend on someone to do something
tip: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

senses.en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet.
Bring something into use or a place for the first time.
Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.

ex.en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
ex.zh: 让我把你介绍给我的新邻居。

ex.en: Schools should introduce practical financial education to help students manage money responsibly in adult life.
ex.zh: 学校应引入实用的理财教育，帮助学生成年后负责任地管理财务。

col: 引导某人了解一门学科
tip: 把甲介绍给乙用introduce A to B，不能用with。

senses.en: relating to society and how people live together
relating to meeting people and spending time with them
living naturally in organised groups rather than alone

ex.en: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
ex.zh: 我的新工作让我几乎没时间参加社交活动。

ex.en: Affordable housing policies can reduce social inequality by helping families access safe homes near essential services.
ex.zh: 可负担住房政策帮助家庭在基本服务设施附近获得安全住所，从而减少社会不平等。

tip: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

senses.en: words expressing pleasure at someone's success or good fortune
said to show happiness about someone's achievement or good news

ex.en: Congratulations on passing your driving test this morning!
ex.zh: 恭喜你今天上午通过了驾照考试！

ex.en: The research team received congratulations from colleagues after winning an international award for environmental innovation.
ex.zh: 研究团队获得国际环境创新奖后，收到了同事们的祝贺。

tip: 祝贺通常用复数；congratulations on后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas.
The design of something or a fashionable appearance.
To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.

ex.en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
ex.zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。

ex.en: Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
ex.zh: 现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。

tip: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

senses.en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.
Ideas or principles taught by a person or tradition.

ex.en: Her love of teaching began at a small village school.
ex.zh: 她对教学的热爱始于一所小乡村学校。

ex.en: Effective teaching should combine clear explanations with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge independently.
ex.zh: 有效的教学应将清晰的讲解与实践活动结合起来，鼓励学生独立运用知识。

tip: 指教学时不可数；指教义或学说常用teachings。

senses.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit
a book or resource giving useful information or instructions
to show someone the way or help them decide

ex.en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
ex.zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。

ex.en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
ex.zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。

tip: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。

senses.en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food.
A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment.
Having a pale yellowish-white colour.

ex.en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
ex.zh: 她把新鲜奶油浇在一碗草莓上。

ex.en: Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.
ex.zh: 用低脂食材替代奶油，可以降低餐食的热量，而不会明显影响风味。

tip: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

ex.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

tip: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

senses.en: Attractive in a sweet or charming way.

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
ex.zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。

ex.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
ex.zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。

tip: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。

senses.en: To plan and arrange an event or activity
To arrange things in a clear, useful order

ex.en: Our neighbours organized a picnic by the river.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居组织了一次河边野餐。

ex.en: Schools should organize practical workshops that help students develop communication skills and prepare for employment.
ex.zh: 学校应组织实践工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通技能并为就业做好准备。

tip: 英式也常拼作organise；organize是规范拼写。

senses.en: To talk informally, in person or through electronic messages.
A friendly, informal conversation.

ex.en: We chatted about our weekend while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公交车时，我们聊起了各自的周末。

ex.en: Community gardens allow neighbours to chat regularly, helping them build stronger relationships and reduce social isolation.
ex.zh: 社区花园让邻居能够经常闲聊，有助于加深彼此的关系，减少社交孤立。

tip: chat with人、about话题；过去式chatted双写t。

senses.en: speaking or behaving without respect for others

ex.en: It was rude to interrupt her during dinner.
ex.zh: 吃晚饭时打断她说话很不礼貌。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to disagree respectfully without making rude comments about others.
ex.zh: 学校应该教孩子如何礼貌地表达不同意见，而不是对他人出言不逊。

tip: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。

senses.en: To push yourself off the ground into the air.
To increase suddenly by a large amount.
An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.

ex.en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
ex.zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。

ex.en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
ex.zh: 在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。

tip: jump at the chance意为欣然抓住机会。

senses.en: to press something or move it away by applying force
to strongly encourage or force someone to act
an act of pushing or a determined effort

ex.en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
ex.zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？

ex.en: Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在学业上进步，而不是迫使他们不断与同学竞争。

tip: push表示推，pull表示拉；push for意为力争。

senses.en: Making something easier to do or understand.
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
ex.zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: Say you are willing to give something or do something.
A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place.
Say how much you are willing to pay.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。

ex.en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
ex.zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。

tip: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

senses.en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell.
Feeling that you might vomit.
Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

ex.en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
ex.zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。

tip: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

senses.en: completely different, or on the other side
facing someone or something from the other side
someone or something completely different from another

ex.en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
ex.zh: 我们离开车站，朝相反的方向走去。

ex.en: Although the policy aimed to reduce traffic, it had the opposite effect in several residential areas.
ex.zh: 尽管该政策旨在减少交通流量，却在几个住宅区产生了相反的效果。

tip: 介词opposite后直接接地点；名词常用the opposite of。

senses.en: To put something over a surface or object.
To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost.
An outer layer that protects or encloses something.

ex.en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
ex.zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。

ex.en: University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 大学奖学金应为低收入家庭的学生支付生活费和学费。

tip: cover A with B表示用B盖住A；cover费用指足以支付。

senses.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.
The ability to think clearly and understand things.

ex.en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
ex.zh: 跌倒时，头盔有助于保护你的大脑。

ex.en: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.
ex.zh: 充足的睡眠有助于大脑正常运作，并帮助学习者更有效地记忆信息。

tip: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

senses.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
ex.zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: Liked or enjoyed by many people.
Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.

ex.en: This small café is popular with local students.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。

ex.en: Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
ex.zh: 通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。

tip: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

senses.en: The number equal to ten hundreds.
A very large quantity, expressed as thousands.

ex.en: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
ex.zh: 维修费总共将近一千美元。

ex.en: Several thousand residents have benefited from the new cycle routes connecting suburban neighbourhoods with the city centre.
ex.zh: 连接郊区社区与市中心的新自行车道已让数千名居民受益。

tip: 具体数词后不加s；泛指数千用thousands of。

senses.en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history.
To store information, sounds, or images for future use.
The best result ever achieved in a particular activity.

ex.en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
ex.zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。

ex.en: Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.
ex.zh: 准确的医疗记录让医护人员能够作出有依据的决定，避免不必要的治疗。

tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: To cook food in an oven using dry heat.

ex.en: I baked some bread while the children set the table.
ex.zh: 孩子们摆餐具时，我烤了些面包。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to bake simple foods as part of practical lessons about nutrition and independence.
ex.zh: 学校可以教孩子烘焙简单的食物，将其作为营养与独立生活实践课的一部分。

tip: bake常用于面包、蛋糕；烤肉通常用roast。

senses.en: A narrow track for people to walk along.
The route along which someone or something moves.
A way of achieving something or developing over time.

ex.en: We followed a narrow path down to the beach.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走向海滩。

ex.en: Access to affordable education can provide a path out of poverty for disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的教育可以为弱势社区提供一条摆脱贫困的道路。

tip: 表示实现目标的途径，用a path to，to后接名词。

senses.en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising
Not known or experienced before

ex.en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。

ex.en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
ex.zh: 在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。

tip: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

senses.en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone
to hold something up or bear its weight
help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up

ex.en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
ex.zh: 每当我尝试新事物时，姐姐都会支持我。

ex.en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。

tip: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

senses.en: the activity of controlling a car or another road vehicle
strongly influencing something and making it happen
blown hard by strong winds

ex.en: Her careful driving made the mountain journey feel safe.
ex.zh: 她开车很谨慎，让这段山路旅程令人安心。

ex.en: Technological innovation is a driving force behind economic growth, although its benefits are not always shared equally.
ex.zh: 技术创新是经济增长的推动力，但其收益并不总能得到公平分享。

tip: driving force意为推动力；driving也可作drive的现在分词。

senses.en: To combine different substances or things.
A combination of different substances, people, or things.
To spend time socially with other people.

ex.en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。

ex.en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
ex.zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。

tip: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。

senses.en: To go or come into a place.
To become involved in a competition, activity, or organisation.
To put information into a computer or official record.

ex.en: Please wipe your shoes before you enter the kitchen.
ex.zh: 进入厨房前，请把鞋底擦干净。

ex.en: Young people often need practical training before they enter the workforce and take on professional responsibilities.
ex.zh: 年轻人在进入职场、承担职业责任之前，往往需要接受实践培训。

tip: 进入某地用enter a place，不加into。

senses.en: not a single person
a person considered unimportant or unknown

ex.en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 没人注意到睡在沙发后面的小猫。

ex.en: Nobody should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 任何人都不应因家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；本身含否定意义。

senses.en: A small control you press to operate something
A small object that fastens clothing through a hole
Fasten clothing using buttons

ex.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
ex.zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

ex.en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
ex.zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。

tip: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。

senses.en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes
giving close attention to details

ex.en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
ex.zh: 小心拿那个碗，那是奶奶以前用的。

ex.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
ex.zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。

tip: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

senses.en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes.
The basic qualities that make something what it is.
The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.

ex.en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
ex.zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。

ex.en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
ex.zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。

tip: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

senses.en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it.
To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour.
Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.

ex.en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。

ex.en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
ex.zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。

tip: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

senses.en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them.
To send something by mail or share it publicly.
A job or position in an organisation.

ex.en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。

ex.en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。

tip: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
ex.zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。

ex.en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
ex.zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。

tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

senses.en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something.
Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.

ex.en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
ex.zh: 我讲解游戏规则时，请认真听。
