ex.en: Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校在关注学生学业进展的同时，也应更加重视他们的情绪健康。

tip: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。

senses.en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion.
A particular contest within a sports competition.

ex.en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
ex.zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。

ex.en: Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.
ex.zh: 举办大型文化活动可以促进当地旅游业，但经济收益的分配可能不均。

tip: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

senses.en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky

ex.en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。

ex.en: Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，许多乡村学校缺乏为学生提供可靠网络连接所需的资源。

tip: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。

senses.en: a meeting to assess someone's suitability for a position
a conversation where someone answers questions for media or research
to ask someone questions for selection, reporting, or research

ex.en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
ex.zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。

ex.en: Researchers should interview residents from diverse backgrounds to understand how housing policies affect different social groups.
ex.zh: 研究人员应访谈不同背景的居民，了解住房政策如何影响不同社会群体。

tip: interviewer是提问者；interviewee是接受面试或采访者。

senses.en: usually, or in most situations
in the usual, expected, or healthy way

ex.en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
ex.zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。

ex.en: Students normally benefit from regular feedback, especially when teachers provide clear guidance on improving their work.
ex.zh: 学生通常能从定期反馈中受益，尤其是在教师明确指导他们改进作业时。

tip: 既可表频率“通常”，也可表状态“正常地”。

senses.en: An opinion or belief about something.
What you can see from a particular place.
To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.

ex.en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
ex.zh: 我的看法是我们应该早点出发。

ex.en: Many residents view investment in public transport as an effective way to reduce urban pollution.
ex.zh: 许多居民认为，投资公共交通是减少城市污染的有效方式。

tip: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。

senses.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.
To cause emotional pain or damage something.
Physically injured or emotionally upset.

ex.en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
ex.zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。

ex.en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
ex.zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

senses.en: Most important or largest among others.
A large pipe or cable supplying water, gas, or electricity.

ex.en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
ex.zh: 正门就在那家小咖啡馆旁边。

ex.en: One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.
ex.zh: 人们迁往城市的一个主要原因是城市提供的就业机会更多。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；主要地用mainly。

senses.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.
A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions.
Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.

ex.en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
ex.zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。

ex.en: The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.
ex.zh: 董事会批准了一项在不裁员、不降薪的前提下减少工厂排放的计划。

tip: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。

senses.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids
to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
ex.zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。

tip: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。

senses.en: The solid surface of the earth.
Reasons or evidence supporting a belief, decision, or action.
To prevent an aircraft from flying.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
ex.zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。

tip: 表示理由常用复数grounds；ground也是grind的过去式。

senses.en: to go from one side to another, or intersect
a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol
annoyed or slightly angry

ex.en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
ex.zh: 我们等车辆停下后才过马路。

ex.en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
ex.zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。

tip: cross是动词；across是介词或副词。

senses.en: From one side of something to the other.
On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area.

senses.zh: 从一边到另一边；在对面
senses.en: From one side to another, or on the opposite side.

ex.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
ex.zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。

ex.en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
ex.zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

ex.en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
ex.zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

tip: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought
Playfully funny in a way that is not serious

ex.en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。

ex.en: Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
ex.zh: 教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。

tip: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。

senses.en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
ex.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
ex.zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

tip: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。

senses.en: To examine things to find similarities and differences.
To describe something as similar to another thing.
To be as good as, or similar to, something else.

ex.en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
ex.zh: 我们比较了几个背包，最后选了最轻的那个。

ex.en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
ex.zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。

tip: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

senses.en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair
to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush
to touch something lightly while moving past it

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
ex.zh: 用软毛刷清理你沾满泥的鞋子。

ex.en: Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.
ex.zh: 儿童应学会正确刷牙，因为良好的习惯可以预防许多牙齿问题。

tip: brush against表示轻擦；brush up on表示温习。

senses.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.
To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.

ex.en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
ex.zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。

ex.en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
ex.zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。

tip: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。

senses.en: For each unit of something.

ex.en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
ex.zh: 这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。

ex.en: Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 减少每户家庭的能源消耗是降低一个国家碳排放的重要一步。

tip: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

senses.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly
To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape
Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread

ex.en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
ex.zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。

ex.en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
ex.zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。

tip: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。

senses.en: a machine that washes dishes and kitchen utensils
a person employed to wash dishes

ex.en: Please load the dishwasher after you finish your lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭吃完后，请把餐具放进洗碗机。

ex.en: Running a dishwasher only when it is full can help households conserve water and energy.
ex.zh: 等洗碗机装满后再运行，有助于家庭节约水和能源。

tip: 日常多指洗碗机；招聘语境中也可指洗碗工。

senses.en: the way something points, moves, or develops
instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something
the control or guidance of an activity or group

ex.en: The dog suddenly ran in the opposite direction.
ex.zh: 那只狗突然朝相反的方向跑去。

ex.en: Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.
ex.zh: 政府投资可以通过支持清洁能源研究来影响技术发展的方向。

tip: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。

senses.en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use.
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
ex.zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

tip: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.en: Used to express that something is definitely true.
Used to agree politely to a request.

ex.en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
ex.zh: 这件暖和的大衣肯定能让你在外面也舒舒服服的。

ex.en: Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通无疑会惠及通勤者，但成效取决于服务是否可靠、票价是否合理。

tip: 常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

senses.en: A small, flat, sweet baked food

senses.zh: 网站存于设备的小型数据
senses.en: A small piece of data a website stores on your device

ex.en: There is one chocolate cookie left in the jar.
ex.zh: 罐子里还剩一块巧克力曲奇。

ex.en: Websites often use cookies to remember user preferences, but some also track browsing behaviour.
ex.zh: 网站常用cookie记住用户偏好，但有些也会追踪浏览行为。

tip: 美式泛指小甜饼；网站cookie不等同于缓存文件。

senses.en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.
Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars.
Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

tip: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。

senses.en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.
Unlikely to fail or lead to loss.
A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
ex.zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

tip: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

senses.en: With someone or something as part of a larger group.

ex.en: Everyone came to the picnic, including our new neighbours.
ex.zh: 大家都来野餐了，包括我们的新邻居。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public spaces for all residents, including older people and those with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 城市应为所有居民提供无障碍公共空间，包括老年人和行动不便者。

tip: including后接名词或代词；included通常放其后。

senses.en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities
something you can choose, or the range of available options
of especially good quality

ex.en: You have a choice between soup and salad.
ex.zh: 你可以在汤和沙拉之间选择。

ex.en: Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通为通勤者提供更多选择，并减少他们对私家车的依赖。

tip: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。

senses.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.
Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air.
New or different from what existed or was used before.

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。

ex.en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
ex.zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

tip: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

senses.en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level
to stretch out your arm towards something or touch it
the distance or extent over which something can act

ex.en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们刚到车站，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
ex.zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。

tip: 表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。

senses.en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen

ex.en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
ex.zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。

ex.en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。

tip: worried形容人担忧；worrying形容事物令人担忧。

senses.en: worried or uneasy about what might happen
relating to the nerves in the body

ex.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
ex.zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

tip: nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。

senses.en: Any longer, usually in negative statements.

ex.en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
ex.zh: 我不再坐公交车上学了。

ex.en: Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.
ex.zh: 许多员工不再每天通勤，因为雇主如今提供灵活的工作安排。

tip: 表示“不再”；英式常写any more，数量“更多”须分写。

senses.en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time.
The act of choosing someone for a job or position.

ex.en: I have a dental appointment early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我预约了明天一早看牙医。

ex.en: Flexible working hours allow employees to attend medical appointments without taking an entire day off.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间让员工无需请一整天假就能按预约就医。

tip: 与某人预约用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。

senses.en: A piece of work that needs to be done.
Give someone responsibility for a particular piece of work.

ex.en: My first task today is to water the plants.
ex.zh: 我今天的第一项任务是给植物浇水。

ex.en: Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.
ex.zh: 把复杂任务分成较小的阶段，可以帮助学生更有效地管理时间。

tip: 作动词用task sb with doing sth，表示指派任务。

senses.en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.

ex.en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
ex.zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。

ex.en: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。

senses.en: How much of something there is.
To total something or be equivalent to it.

ex.en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
ex.zh: 往碗里加少量牛奶。

ex.en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。

tip: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

senses.en: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.

ex.en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
ex.zh: 我们分吃了一碗冰淇淋作为餐后甜点。

ex.en: Offering fresh fruit for dessert can help school cafeterias encourage healthier eating habits among children.
ex.zh: 学校食堂提供新鲜水果作为餐后甜点，有助于培养儿童更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: dessert有两个s，重音在后；desert作沙漠时重音在前。

senses.en: one of the long movable parts of a hand
to touch or handle something with your fingers

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

senses.en: Earth's solid surface, or an area used for a particular purpose.
To reach the ground, or bring an aircraft to the ground.
To succeed in getting something desirable, especially a job.

ex.en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
ex.zh: 在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。

ex.en: Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
ex.zh: 保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。

tip: 表示土地通常不可数；land a job指成功获得工作。

senses.en: the outer form of something
to influence how something develops
to give something a particular physical form

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。

ex.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
ex.zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

tip: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

senses.en: armed fighting between countries or groups
a determined effort to defeat something harmful

ex.en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。

ex.en: War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
ex.zh: 战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。

tip: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

senses.en: in or to a foreign country

ex.en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
ex.zh: 我姐姐移居国外，现在住在海边。

ex.en: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
ex.zh: 出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。

tip: abroad是副词：说go abroad，不说go to abroad。

senses.en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another
a process of personal change or development over time
to travel from one place to another

ex.en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。

ex.en: Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以缩短每日通勤时间，并鼓励通勤者不开车出门。

tip: journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

senses.en: Kept hidden from people who should not know.
Information known only to a limited group of people.
An important way of achieving a particular result.

ex.en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。

ex.en: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
ex.zh: 政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。

tip: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: a choice made after considering different possibilities

ex.en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
ex.zh: 搬到离工作地点更近的地方是个明智的决定。

ex.en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
ex.zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。

tip: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

senses.en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences
something from the past that you remember
the part of a computer that stores information

ex.en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
ex.zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。

ex.en: Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能改善记忆力，帮助老年人更长久地保持独立生活的能力。

tip: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

senses.en: a qualification awarded after completing a university course
the amount or level of something
a unit used to measure temperature or angles

ex.en: My cousin earned a degree in engineering last summer.
ex.zh: 我表姐去年夏天获得了工程学学位。

ex.en: Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.
ex.zh: 虽然大学学位能改善就业前景，但实践经验在许多行业仍然十分重要。

tip: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

senses.en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served
a long narrow piece of solid material
to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something

ex.en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
ex.zh: 我们在酒店的酒吧点了鲜榨橙汁。

ex.en: Sports centres should not bar residents from using essential facilities simply because they cannot afford membership fees.
ex.zh: 体育中心不应仅因居民付不起会员费，就禁止他们使用基本设施。

tip: 表禁止用bar sb from doing；过去式barred。

senses.en: One of the main yearly periods with particular weather conditions.
A period when a particular activity or event usually happens.
Add salt, herbs, or spices to improve food's flavour.

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。

ex.en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

tip: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

senses.en: For everyone to use, see, or know about.
Provided or controlled by the government.
Ordinary people in society considered as a group.

ex.en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
ex.zh: 这座公共花园每天开放到日落。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地上班，同时减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

senses.en: A set of connected parts that work together.
An organised structure through which services or institutions operate.
An organised way of doing something.

ex.en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
ex.zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。

ex.en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
ex.zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。

tip: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

senses.en: a type, arrangement, or shape of something
a document with spaces for providing requested information
to develop, create, or combine into something

ex.en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
ex.zh: 那些云呈现出一只巨兔的形状。

ex.en: Online learning has become a popular form of education because it offers flexibility for working adults.
ex.zh: 在线学习已成为一种受欢迎的教育形式，因为它为在职成年人提供了灵活性。

tip: fill in a form是英式说法；美式常用fill out a form。

senses.en: a word naming a person, place, thing, quality, or idea

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to circle every noun.
ex.zh: 老师让我们把每个名词都圈出来。

ex.en: Understanding whether a noun is countable helps language learners choose appropriate articles and express quantities accurately in academic writing.
ex.zh: 了解名词是否可数，有助于语言学习者在学术写作中选用合适的冠词并准确表达数量。

tip: 名词不只指实物，也可指advice等抽象概念。

senses.en: something you do regularly, often without thinking

ex.en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
ex.zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。

ex.en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
ex.zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。

tip: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。

senses.en: intelligent or showing good judgment
neat, stylish, and suitable for a formal occasion
using computer technology to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
ex.zh: 用那个办法修好架子真聪明。

ex.en: Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.
ex.zh: 智能灌溉系统可根据土壤状况调节供水，从而减少水资源浪费。

tip: 英式常指衣着整洁时髦；美式常指聪明。

senses.en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
To eat small amounts of food between main meals.

ex.en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

senses.en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides.
To welcome someone arriving at a place.

ex.en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
ex.zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？

ex.en: All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.
ex.zh: 在新线路开通之前，所有居民都应获得有关公共交通调整的明确信息。

tip: receive侧重收到；accept侧重愿意接受。

senses.en: A comfortable seat for two or more people.
To express something in a particular way.

ex.en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。

ex.en: Public health advice should be couched in clear language so that everyone can understand it.
ex.zh: 公共卫生建议应以清晰的语言表述，让每个人都能理解。

tip: 动词常用be couched in，指以某种措辞表达。

senses.en: To think something is probably true without being certain.
To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.

ex.en: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
ex.zh: 我想，如果天气一直这么暖和，我们可以在外面吃饭。

ex.en: Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
ex.zh: 假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。

tip: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

senses.en: Written words, especially the main written content of something.
A short written message sent using a phone.
Send someone a short written message using a phone.

ex.en: The text on this menu is too small.
ex.zh: 这份菜单上的字太小了。

ex.en: Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
ex.zh: 教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

senses.en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
ex.zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services
a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body
a piece of paper money, especially in American English

ex.en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
ex.zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。

ex.en: The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 这项拟议法案将要求企业披露更多有关其环境影响的信息。

tip: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

senses.en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events.
Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement.
Someone who often visits the same place.

ex.en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
ex.zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。

ex.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。

tip: regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。

senses.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group.
A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.

ex.en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。

ex.en: The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 这篇文章探讨了在密集人口城市中，绿地的可及性如何影响心理健康。

tip: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

senses.en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something.
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技能。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

senses.en: a sliding storage compartment in a desk or other furniture

ex.en: I keep spare keys in the top kitchen drawer.
ex.zh: 我把备用钥匙放在厨房最上面的抽屉里。

ex.en: Office desks with lockable drawers help employees store personal belongings securely in shared working environments.
ex.zh: 配有可上锁抽屉的办公桌有助于员工在共享办公环境中安全存放私人物品。

tip: 抽屉是drawer；衣橱是wardrobe。

senses.en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone.
Owned or managed independently of the government.
Not intended to be known or shared with others.

ex.en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
ex.zh: 每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。

ex.en: Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.
ex.zh: 私营公司可以改善公共交通，但政府必须确保票价仍在民众承受范围内。

tip: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

senses.en: in, at, or to all places

ex.en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。

ex.en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
ex.zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。

tip: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

senses.en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines.
A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.

ex.en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
ex.zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。

ex.en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
ex.zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。

tip: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

senses.en: A formal talk given to an audience.
The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.

ex.en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
ex.zh: 莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。

ex.en: In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人员在演讲中解释了接触绿地如何改善儿童的心理健康。

tip: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

senses.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest.
To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm.
A regular pulse of sound or movement.

ex.en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋赢了我。

ex.en: Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.
ex.zh: 运动员需要持续训练和心理支持，才能在国际赛事中击败最强劲的对手。

tip: 过去式 beat，过去分词 beaten；赢比赛用 win。

senses.en: to move something higher or increase its amount or level
to collect money for a particular purpose
to care for children or animals as they grow

ex.en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
ex.zh: 如果你还需要一支铅笔，请举手。

ex.en: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。

tip: raise是及物动词，后接宾语；rise表示自身上升。

senses.en: without anyone else present
without other people or their help
only, excluding everything or everyone else

ex.en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
ex.zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。

ex.en: Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
ex.zh: 政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。

tip: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

senses.en: treating people equally or reasonably
having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
ex.zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。

ex.en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。

tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

senses.en: not curved or bent
directly, without turning or stopping
honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

senses.en: Sleeping rather than awake.

ex.en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
ex.zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。

ex.en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。

tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

senses.en: the number equal to a thousand thousands

ex.en: The city now has more than a million residents.
ex.zh: 这座城市如今有一百多万居民。

ex.en: The government plans to invest several million pounds in renewable energy projects over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府计划在未来十年向可再生能源项目投入数百万英镑。

tip: 具体数词后million不加s；millions of表示数百万。

senses.en: Someone you work, play, or share a business with.
Someone you share a romantic relationship or married life with.
Work or take part in an activity with someone.

ex.en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
ex.zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。

ex.en: Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.
ex.zh: 大学可以与当地企业合作，让学生在就业前获得实践经验。

tip: partner不表明性别；作动词常用partner with。

senses.en: to answer someone or respond to a message
an answer given in speech or writing

ex.en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
ex.zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。

ex.en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
ex.zh: 地方官员应及时答复对公共交通服务提出担忧的居民。

tip: reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: an enclosed appliance used to bake or roast food

ex.en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
ex.zh: 面包刚出烤箱，还热乎着。

ex.en: Using an energy-efficient oven can reduce household electricity consumption without changing cooking habits significantly.
ex.zh: 使用节能烤箱可以减少家庭用电量，而不必大幅改变烹饪习惯。

tip: oven指封闭烤箱；炉顶灶具通常叫hob或stove。

senses.en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics
to arrange things in groups or a particular order
to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter

ex.en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
ex.zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？

ex.en: Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。

tip: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: How good or bad something is.
A characteristic of a person or thing.
Of a high standard.

ex.en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
ex.zh: 以这个价格来说，这双鞋的质量让我感到惊喜。

ex.en: Governments should improve the quality of public transport before encouraging people to give up driving.
ex.zh: 政府应先提高公共交通的质量，再鼓励人们放弃开车。

tip: 表示质量通常不可数；表示特质时可数。

senses.en: A spoken or written account giving information about something
To give information about an event or situation
To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge

ex.en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
ex.zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。

ex.en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。

tip: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

senses.en: an idea offered for someone to consider
a slight sign that something exists or may be true

ex.en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
ex.zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。

ex.en: The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.
ex.zh: 扩建自行车道的建议得到了关注道路安全的居民的大力支持。

tip: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

senses.en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things.
To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly.
Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.

ex.en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我在外套口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
ex.zh: 当无法上网或网络不稳定时，袖珍词典对语言学习者仍然很有用。

tip: pocket money指零花钱，英式英语中常用。

senses.en: At the side of someone or something.

ex.en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿靴子放在门旁边。

ex.en: Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.
ex.zh: 在城市河流旁修建步道可以鼓励身体活动，并让居民更容易亲近自然。

tip: beside表示“在旁边”；besides表示“此外；除……之外”。

senses.en: without waiting or any delay
directly before, after, or next to something
as soon as something happens

ex.en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
ex.zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。

ex.en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
ex.zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。

tip: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。

senses.en: To use physical force against another person or group.
To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal.
An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.

ex.en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
ex.zh: 两只猫为了窗边一个有阳光的位置打了起来。

ex.en: Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府应通过改善教育和医疗服务的可及性、增加稳定就业机会来消除贫困。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

senses.en: More than two but not many
A few people or things already mentioned or understood

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
ex.zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。

ex.en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

senses.en: to let someone do something
to make something possible
to provide enough time or resources for something

ex.en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
ex.zh: 图书馆允许访客一次借五本书。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。

tip: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose or situation

ex.en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
ex.zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。

tip: 常用it is necessary to do；necessarily意为“必然地”。

senses.en: How heavy someone or something is.
A heavy object used for exercise or measuring weight.
The importance or influence given to something.

ex.en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱太重，很难提起来。

ex.en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
ex.zh: 政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。

tip: weight是名词；weigh是动词：How much does it weigh?

senses.en: A person or organisation that buys goods or services.

ex.en: The customer asked for a larger pair of shoes.
ex.zh: 这位顾客想要一双大一点的鞋。

ex.en: Businesses can build customer loyalty by providing reliable products and responding quickly to complaints.
ex.zh: 企业可以通过提供可靠的产品并迅速回应投诉来培养客户忠诚度。

tip: customer泛指顾客；client常指专业服务的客户。

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

senses.en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes
Exchange a cheque for money

ex.en: I keep some cash in my wallet for emergencies.
ex.zh: 我在钱包里放了一些现金，以备急用。

ex.en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, many small businesses still prefer customers to pay in cash.
ex.zh: 尽管电子支付日益普及，许多小商家仍然更希望顾客用现金付款。

tip: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。

senses.en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.

ex.en: Her grandparents saved money to pay for her education.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母攒钱供她读书。

ex.en: Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.
ex.zh: 获得优质教育的机会能够改善就业前景，并缩小不同社会群体之间的不平等。

tip: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

senses.en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed.
A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.

ex.en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
ex.zh: 我在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生使用每张纸的正反两面，以减少纸张浪费。

tip: sheet是可数名词；一张纸说a sheet of paper。

senses.en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event.
Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.

ex.en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
ex.zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。

ex.en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
ex.zh: 酒店可以仅在住客提出要求时更换毛巾，以鼓励节水。

tip: guest可指受邀客人，也可指付费的酒店住客。

senses.en: Happening once a week or relating to one week
Once every week
A newspaper or magazine published once a week

ex.en: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
ex.zh: 我们每周的购物之行通常以去面包店收尾。

ex.en: Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周开设的健身课可以帮助老年居民保持活力并建立社交联系。

tip: 既可作形容词也可作副词：a weekly meeting；meet weekly。

senses.en: A set of rooms forming one home within a building.

ex.en: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓有一个面向公园的小阳台。

ex.en: Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.
ex.zh: 在火车站附近建设价格可负担的公寓，可以降低年轻上班族的通勤成本。

tip: 美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

senses.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow
to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger

ex.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
ex.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。

ex.en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
ex.zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。

tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

senses.en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks
to attack someone in public and steal from them

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a mug of tea.
ex.zh: 我双手捧着一大杯茶取暖。

ex.en: Providing reusable mugs in offices can reduce the waste generated by disposable cups each day.
ex.zh: 在办公室提供可重复使用的杯子，可以减少每天由一次性杯子产生的垃圾。

tip: mug通常有柄、较大；作动词可指拦路抢劫。

senses.en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition
to gain points in a game, test, or competition
music written for a film or the written music itself

ex.en: My score improved after a week of practice.
ex.zh: 练习一周后，我的分数提高了。

ex.en: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
ex.zh: 考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。

tip: score可作名词或动词；score a goal指进球得分。

senses.en: Something discussed, studied, or taught.
Affected by something or dependent on a condition.
To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
ex.zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。

ex.en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。

tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

senses.en: an official rule, or the system of such rules
the study or profession concerned with legal rules
a general scientific rule describing how something always behaves

ex.en: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
ex.zh: 法律要求驾驶员在红灯前停车。

ex.en: Governments should enforce environmental laws consistently to prevent businesses from gaining advantages through harmful practices.
ex.zh: 政府应始终如一地执行环境法律，防止企业通过有害行为获取优势。

tip: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。

senses.en: a metal container used for cooking or baking food
to criticize a performance, book, or film very harshly
to turn a camera slowly across a scene

ex.en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding onions.
ex.zh: 先把锅里的油烧热，再放入洋葱。

ex.en: Television chefs can encourage healthier eating by demonstrating how to prepare nutritious meals using a single pan.
ex.zh: 电视厨师可以通过演示如何用一口锅烹制营养餐，来鼓励更健康的饮食。

col: 受到评论家的严厉批评
tip: 作动词时过去式为panned，现在分词为panning。

senses.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.
To put things in order and make a place neat.

ex.en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
ex.zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。

ex.en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
ex.zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。

tip: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

senses.en: Not including a particular person or thing.
Used to introduce a fact limiting what was just said.

ex.en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
ex.zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。

ex.en: The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 拟议的交通政策惠及大多数居民，但偏远农村社区的居民除外。

tip: except排除在外；besides表示另外还包括。

senses.en: A dirty or untidy state or collection of things.
A situation full of problems or confusion.
To make something untidy or spoil it, usually with up.

ex.en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
ex.zh: 我们烤完饼干后，厨房一片狼藉。

ex.en: Without clear responsibilities, a community project can quickly become a mess, wasting both time and resources.
ex.zh: 如果职责不清，社区项目很快就可能陷入混乱，既浪费时间又浪费资源。

tip: 常说make a mess；mess up可指弄乱或搞砸。

senses.en: A spice used to give food a hot flavour.
A hollow vegetable that can taste sweet or hot.
To cover or fill something with many small things.

ex.en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
ex.zh: 能把胡椒粉递给我，让我加到汤里吗？

ex.en: Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.
ex.zh: 农民可以在温室里种植甜椒，以维持全年的稳定食物供应。

col: 在某事物中加入大量例子
tip: 胡椒粉不可数；指一个甜椒时可说a pepper。

senses.en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property
to pay to use something owned by someone else
to let someone use your property in exchange for payment

ex.en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
ex.zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。

ex.en: Rising rents in urban areas can force essential workers to live further from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 城市地区租金上涨可能迫使提供基本服务的劳动者住得离工作地点更远。

tip: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。

senses.en: not open
not available for business or public use
unwilling to consider different ideas

ex.en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
ex.zh: 开着暖气时，请把窗户关好。

ex.en: When local libraries remain closed at weekends, working families have fewer opportunities to access educational resources.
ex.zh: 如果当地图书馆周末不开放，上班族家庭获取教育资源的机会就会减少。

tip: 形容词意为“关着的”；也是close的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: To cause a person, animal, or other organism to die
To cause something to stop or fail

ex.en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
ex.zh: 这种肥皂有助于杀灭手上的病菌。

ex.en: Excessive use of pesticides can kill beneficial insects and disrupt the natural balance of agricultural ecosystems.
ex.zh: 过量使用农药会杀死益虫，破坏农业生态系统的自然平衡。

tip: kill强调造成死亡；die表示自身死亡，不接宾语。

senses.en: Making someone feel afraid or nervous.

ex.en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
ex.zh: 那个吓人的声音只不过是树枝在碰窗户。

ex.en: Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 开始上学可能让年幼的孩子害怕，因此教师应营造友善的环境。

tip: scary形容事物吓人；scared形容人感到害怕。

senses.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

ex.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

tip: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

senses.en: An object used to build, repair, or make things.
Something that helps you perform a task or achieve something.

ex.en: This small tool helps me tighten the loose screws.
ex.zh: 这个小工具帮我拧紧松动的螺丝。

ex.en: Digital maps are a valuable tool for urban planners seeking to design more accessible public transport networks.
ex.zh: 数字地图是城市规划者设计更便捷的公共交通网络的重要辅助工具。

tip: tool是可数名词；equipment通常不可数。

senses.zh: 在任何地方；去任何地方
senses.en: in or to any place
in any place, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
ex.zh: 在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。

ex.en: Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
ex.zh: 可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。

tip: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

senses.en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals
a particular area of study or work
an area of ground used for playing a sport

ex.en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
ex.zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。

ex.en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。

senses.en: information and understanding gained through learning or experience
awareness of a particular fact or situation

ex.en: My grandfather shared his knowledge of birds with me.
ex.zh: 祖父和我分享了他对鸟类的了解。

ex.en: Schools should help students apply their knowledge to practical problems rather than simply memorise facts.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生运用知识解决实际问题，而不只是记忆事实。

col: 在某人不知情的情况下
tip: 通常不可数；可说a good knowledge of某领域。

senses.en: the achievement of an aim or a desired result
a person or thing that achieves a good result

ex.en: The school concert was a success despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下了雨，学校音乐会还是很成功。

ex.en: Long-term success in education depends not only on funding but also on the quality of teaching.
ex.zh: 教育的长期成功不仅取决于资金投入，也取决于教学质量。

tip: 泛指成功时不可数；a success指成功的人或事。

senses.en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things.
To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.

ex.en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
ex.zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。

tip: “垃圾桶”英式常说bin，美式常说trash can。

senses.en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar

ex.en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
ex.zh: 她给每位客人递了一小块糖果。

ex.en: Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 限制面向儿童的糖果广告，可以帮助家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。

senses.en: Taking long walks outdoors, especially in the countryside.

ex.en: These boots keep my feet dry when I go hiking.
ex.zh: 我去远足时，这双靴子能让双脚保持干爽。

ex.en: Hiking offers an affordable way to improve physical health while encouraging people to appreciate natural landscapes.
ex.zh: 徒步旅行是一种经济实惠的健身方式，也能鼓励人们欣赏自然风光。

tip: 通常指乡野长途步行；也可作hike的现在分词。

senses.en: failed to catch, attend, or take advantage of something
failed to hit or notice someone or something
felt sad because someone or something was absent

ex.en: We missed the bus and walked home together.
ex.zh: 我们没赶上公交车，便一起走回了家。

ex.en: Students who missed lessons due to illness should receive additional support to catch up with their classmates.
ex.zh: 因病缺课的学生应获得额外帮助，以跟上同学的学习进度。

tip: miss的过去式和过去分词；词尾-ed读/t/。

senses.en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience
to cause someone worry or ask them for help

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。

ex.en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
ex.zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

col: take the trouble to do something
tip: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

senses.en: Moving to a position on a surface.

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
ex.zh: 猫跳到我旁边的沙发上。

ex.en: Moving freight onto trains could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from the transport sector.
ex.zh: 将货物转移到火车上运输，可以缓解道路拥堵并降低运输业的排放。

tip: onto强调移动到表面；on常表示已在上面。

senses.en: shaped like a circle or ball
one stage in a repeated series of activities
around something or on all sides of it

ex.en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。

ex.en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。

tip: round作介词常见于英式英语，美式多用around。

senses.en: The usually flat, green parts of plants.
Goes away from somewhere, or lets something remain.

ex.en: Golden leaves covered the path outside our house.
ex.zh: 金黄色的落叶铺满了我们家门外的小路。

ex.en: Fallen leaves provide habitats for small organisms and return valuable nutrients to the soil as they decompose.
ex.zh: 落叶为小型生物提供栖息地，并在分解时将宝贵的养分归还土壤。

tip: 既是leaf的复数，也是leave的第三人称单数形式。

senses.en: A book used to study a particular subject.
Showing exactly how something usually happens or should be done.

ex.en: I left my science textbook on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把科学课本落在厨房桌上了。

ex.en: Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.
ex.zh: 电子教材可以降低学校开支，不过一些学生觉得纸质材料更便于学习。

tip: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。

senses.en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches
an area of land covered with trees

ex.en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
ex.zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。

ex.en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
ex.zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。

tip: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

senses.en: something made or grown to be sold or used
something that results from a process or situation
the result of multiplying two or more quantities

ex.en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
ex.zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。

tip: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

senses.en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity
become twice as much, or make something twice as much
an amount that is twice as large as another

ex.en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午饭点了双份米饭。

ex.en: The city plans to double its investment in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 该市计划将自行车基础设施投资增加一倍，以缓解交通拥堵。

tip: double表示变为原来的两倍，即增加一倍。

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
The beginning of something new.

ex.en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
ex.zh: 全家人都庆祝了我们女儿的出生。

ex.en: Access to skilled medical care during birth significantly improves health outcomes for both mothers and newborn babies.
ex.zh: 分娩时获得专业医疗护理能显著改善母亲和新生儿的健康状况。

tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

senses.en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates
To move or travel very fast
To drive faster than the legal limit

ex.en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
ex.zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。

ex.en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
ex.zh: 降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。

tip: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

senses.en: Air moving naturally outdoors.
To wrap something around an object or itself.
To follow a route with many bends and turns.

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
ex.zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

tip: 风读/wɪnd/；缠绕读/waɪnd/，过去式wound。

senses.en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.

ex.en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.
ex.zh: 居民描述了过度拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁制定更严格的安全标准。

tip: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

senses.en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift
Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity
Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty

ex.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。

ex.en: Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.
ex.zh: 繁忙的交通加剧了城市空气污染，也增加了人们的通勤时间。

tip: 大雨用heavy rain，不用big rain。

senses.en: A sweet spread made by cooking fruit with sugar.
A situation where movement stops because things are packed together.
To become stuck, or force something into a tight space.

ex.en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。

ex.en: Frequent traffic jams increase air pollution and make daily journeys more stressful for urban residents.
ex.zh: 频繁的交通拥堵加剧空气污染，也让城市居民的日常出行更加令人焦虑。

tip: 果酱通常不可数；一次交通堵塞用a traffic jam。

senses.en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying things
to dry someone or something with a towel

ex.en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
ex.zh: 他把一条温暖的毛巾裹在湿漉漉的肩膀上。

ex.en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse their towels during their stay.
ex.zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客在入住期间重复使用毛巾，以减少用水量。

tip: 可数名词；paper towel指吸水纸巾，不是布毛巾。

senses.en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body
to accept responsibility for something difficult

ex.en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
ex.zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。

ex.en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 政府和企业必须承担更大的责任，减少工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

senses.en: for all future time
very often, especially in an annoying way

ex.en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
ex.zh: 我希望这些阳光明媚的午后能永远持续下去。

ex.en: Without effective conservation measures, some rare animal species could disappear forever within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果没有有效的保护措施，一些珍稀动物物种可能在未来几十年内永远消失。

tip: be forever doing常表示不满：老是做某事。

senses.en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.

ex.en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
ex.zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
ex.zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。

tip: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

senses.en: Worse than all others in quality, condition, or effect.
More badly or severely than anyone or anything else.

senses.zh: 最坏的情况；最糟的部分
senses.en: The most unpleasant situation, outcome, or part.

ex.en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
ex.zh: 那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。

ex.en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。

tip: worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。

senses.en: A deep container used for cooking food.
A container used for plants, storage, or serving drinks.
To put a plant into a container with soil.

ex.en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
ex.zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。

ex.en: Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
ex.zh: 用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。

tip: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

senses.en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers.
Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working.
A formal religious ceremony.

ex.en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。

ex.en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
ex.zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。

tip: 表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。

senses.en: Different from what is common, normal, or expected.

ex.en: This carrot has an unusual shape, like a tiny hand.
ex.zh: 这根胡萝卜的形状很特别，像一只小手。

ex.en: Scientists are investigating unusual weather patterns that may be linked to rising global temperatures.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究可能与全球气温上升有关的异常天气模式。

tip: It is unusual for sb to do表示某人很少这样做。

senses.en: Less good or more unpleasant, harmful, or serious.
Less well or more badly.

ex.en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
ex.zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。

ex.en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。

tip: bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。

senses.en: A place where two sides, walls, or streets meet.
To trap someone so they cannot escape or avoid answering.

ex.en: We put a small lamp in the corner.
ex.zh: 我们在角落里放了一盏小灯。

ex.en: Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 街角商店让当地居民更方便地获得日常服务，从而鼓励人们步行。

tip: 室内角落用in the corner；街道拐角常用on或at。

senses.en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire.
To damage skin or other material through heat.
An injury caused by heat, chemicals, or electricity.

ex.en: A small fire burned quietly in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁炉里，一小团火静静地燃烧着。

ex.en: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases, making cleaner energy sources essential for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 燃烧化石燃料会释放温室气体，因此清洁能源对环境保护至关重要。

tip: 过去式和过去分词可用burnt或burned。

senses.en: warmth or a high temperature
to make or become warmer
a race that decides who enters the next round

ex.en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
ex.zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。

ex.en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。

tip: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

senses.en: relating to Korea, its people, or its language
the language spoken in North and South Korea
a person from North or South Korea

ex.en: Our neighbour showed us how to make Korean dumplings.
ex.zh: 邻居教我们怎样包韩式饺子。

ex.en: Korean cinema has attracted international audiences, encouraging wider interest in the country's language and cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 韩国电影吸引了国际观众，激发了人们对该国语言和文化传统的更广泛兴趣。

tip: Korean可指朝鲜半岛两国，具体含义看语境。

senses.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases
The small, hard ball used in this sport

ex.en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们在公园打棒球。

ex.en: Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.
ex.zh: 棒球等团队运动能帮助年轻人培养合作能力并保持身体健康。

tip: 运动名称不可数；表示一个棒球时用a baseball。

senses.en: plan how something will look or work before making it
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: My cousin designed a wooden desk for her bedroom.
ex.zh: 我表姐为自己的卧室设计了一张木书桌。

ex.en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。

tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: the planet where humans and other known living things exist
the loose material on the ground in which plants grow

ex.en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
ex.zh: 孩子们用小铲子挖开湿润的泥土。

ex.en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
ex.zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。

tip: 指行星时常写Earth；on earth中不加the。

senses.en: Containing nothing or having no people inside.
To remove everything from a container or place.
Lacking real meaning, value, or sincere intention.

ex.en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
ex.zh: 我打开饼干盒时，里面已经空了。

ex.en: Converting empty office buildings into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
ex.zh: 将空置办公楼改造成可负担住房，可以帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。

tip: empty强调里面没有东西；vacant常指房屋或职位空缺。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.

ex.en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
ex.zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。

ex.en: Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.
ex.zh: 将公共交通服务延长至午夜之后，将有利于目前依赖昂贵出租车出行的轮班工作者。

tip: 在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。

senses.en: to hit a surface, especially a door, to make a sound
to hit something accidentally, often making it move or fall
a sound or blow caused by hitting something

ex.en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
ex.zh: 进来之前请先敲门。

ex.en: Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.
ex.zh: 强风可能刮倒树木，严重扰乱城市地区的交通网络。

tip: 词首k不发音；敲门用knock on或at the door。

senses.en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted

ex.en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
ex.zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
ex.zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。

tip: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

senses.en: the main unit of money used in the United Kingdom
a unit of weight equal to about 454 grams
to hit repeatedly with force or beat strongly

ex.en: I paid one pound for this bag of apples.
ex.zh: 我花了一英镑买了这袋苹果。

ex.en: A weaker pound can attract international tourists, but it also raises the cost of imported goods.
ex.zh: 英镑贬值可以吸引国际游客，但也会提高进口商品的成本。

tip: 英镑和重量单位磅都用pound；复数通常加s。

senses.en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.

ex.en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 我在蔬菜汤里加了些豆子。

ex.en: Beans provide an affordable source of protein and can support a balanced plant-based diet.
ex.zh: 豆类是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，有助于形成均衡的植物性饮食。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用豆类时通常用beans。

senses.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
ex.zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。

ex.en: Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。

tip: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.
How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
ex.zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

ex.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

tip: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

ex.en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
ex.zh: 在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。

ex.en: Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
ex.zh: 透明面罩可以帮助那些依靠观察嘴唇来理解话语的人更顺畅地交流。

tip: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

senses.en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.

ex.en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这种番茄酱汁配新鲜意面很好吃。

ex.en: Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.
ex.zh: 在家制作酱汁，能让家庭控制饭菜中的盐和糖含量。

tip: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。

senses.en: something that makes an event or situation happen
make something happen, especially something unpleasant
an aim or principle that people support and work towards

ex.en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
ex.zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。

tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

senses.en: Correct in every detail, without any difference or error.
Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.

ex.en: Can you tell me the exact time we should arrive?
ex.zh: 你能告诉我我们应该到达的确切时间吗？

ex.en: Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要精确的测量数据，以判断空气质量变化是否与新的交通政策有关。

tip: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

senses.en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot
a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar
a connection between people, groups, or places

ex.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
ex.zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。

ex.en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
ex.zh: 学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。

tip: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

ex.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。

ex.en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
ex.zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。

tip: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

senses.en: Sliced bread browned and made crisp by heat.
To heat food until it becomes brown and crisp.
An occasion when people raise drinks to honour someone or something.

ex.en: I spread butter on my toast while it was warm.
ex.zh: 我趁烤面包片还热着，在上面抹了黄油。

ex.en: A simple breakfast of toast and fruit can help students maintain their energy during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 一顿由烤面包片和水果组成的简单早餐，有助于学生在上午上课时保持精力。

tip: 表示烤面包时不可数；表示一次祝酒时可数。

senses.en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere.
A series of performances or matches held in different places.
To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.

ex.en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
ex.zh: 我们在导游带领下参观了那座古堡。

ex.en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
ex.zh: 有组织的游览既能让游客了解当地传统，也能为社区导游提供稳定收入。

tip: tour强调参观或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。

senses.en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food
A place where a road or path divides
Divide into separate branches or directions

ex.en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
ex.zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。

ex.en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。

tip: 道路forks表示分叉；a fork in the road指岔路口。

senses.en: in a way that is not the same

ex.en: My sister and I arrange our desks differently.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐布置书桌的方式不同。

ex.en: Students learn differently, so teachers should offer varied activities rather than rely on a single method.
ex.zh: 学生的学习方式各不相同，因此教师应提供多样化活动，而不是依赖单一方法。

tip: 副词修饰动词；形容人或事物不同用different。

senses.en: A smooth surface, usually glass, that shows a reflected image.
Show the same qualities, changes, or features as something else.

ex.en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
ex.zh: 他离开前照镜子检查了一下头发。

ex.en: Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.
ex.zh: 消费者支出的变化往往反映更广泛的经济趋势，在金融形势不明朗时期尤其如此。

tip: 照镜子用look in the mirror，不用look the mirror。

senses.en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.

ex.en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
ex.zh: 她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。

ex.en: Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
ex.zh: 选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。

tip: pillow主要用于睡觉；cushion多指靠垫或坐垫。

senses.en: a long reptile without legs
to move or extend along a winding path

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。

ex.en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
ex.zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

senses.en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle.
To connect separated things or reduce differences between them.
A card game played by four people in two partnerships.

ex.en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
ex.zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。

ex.en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
ex.zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。

tip: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

senses.zh: 建造；建立（过去式及分词）
senses.en: past tense and past participle of build
having a particular body shape or physical build

ex.en: We built a small shelter for the garden tools.
ex.zh: 我们搭了一个小棚子，用来存放园艺工具。

ex.en: New homes should be built near public transport to reduce residents' dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 新住宅应建在公共交通设施附近，以减少居民对私家车的依赖。

col: 体格健壮的；建造牢固的
tip: build的过去式、过去分词均为built，不是builded。

senses.en: Used when something may happen or may be true.
Used with can or could to emphasise possibility or difficulty.

ex.en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
ex.zh: 如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。

ex.en: Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 扩大城市绿地可能降低夏季气温，同时改善居民的身心健康。

tip: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

senses.en: Feeling afraid of something or worried that something bad might happen.

ex.en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
ex.zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。

ex.en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
ex.zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。

tip: scared形容感到害怕；scary形容令人害怕。

senses.en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area
The amount of data or messages passing through a system

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

senses.en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums

ex.en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
ex.zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。

ex.en: Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.
ex.zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小的牙齿问题发展成严重的健康问题。

tip: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

senses.en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle.
The circular control used to steer a vehicle.
To move something along on its wheels.

ex.en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
ex.zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。

ex.en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
ex.zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

tip: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

senses.en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work

ex.en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
ex.zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。

ex.en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。

tip: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。

senses.en: To go back, or give something back.
The act of coming or going back.
Money or benefits gained from an investment or activity.

ex.en: Please return these library books before you go away.
ex.zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。

tip: return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

senses.en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer
Recognize that something is true or valid
Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation

ex.en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。

ex.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
ex.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

tip: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

senses.en: A journey through the air, especially in an aircraft.
The act or ability of moving through the air.
A continuous set of stairs between floors or landings.

ex.en: Our flight leaves early, so we should pack tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的航班出发很早，所以今晚应该收拾好行李。

ex.en: Reducing the number of short domestic flights could lower emissions where reliable rail alternatives already exist.
ex.zh: 在已有可靠铁路替代方案的地区，减少短途国内航班可以降低排放。

tip: a flight of stairs指两层或平台之间的一段楼梯。

senses.en: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe.
A thin pointed metal piece used to fasten materials together.
To attach something using nails.

ex.en: I cut my nails before my piano lesson.
ex.zh: 我在上钢琴课前剪了指甲。

ex.en: Teaching children to keep their nails clean can help establish healthy personal hygiene habits early.
ex.zh: 教孩子保持指甲清洁，有助于他们尽早养成良好的个人卫生习惯。

tip: 既指指甲也指钉子；作动词表示用钉子固定。

senses.en: to finish doing something or filling in information
having every necessary part, with nothing missing
total, without any limit or exception

ex.en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我刚拼好拼图，晚饭就做好了。

ex.en: Students who complete vocational training often gain practical skills that help them enter the workforce more confidently.
ex.zh: 完成职业培训的学生往往能获得实用技能，从而更有信心地进入职场。

tip: complete a form指填写完表格，不是制作表格。

senses.en: a word that describes a person, thing, or state

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to find adjectives describing weather.
ex.zh: 老师让我们找出描述天气的形容词。

ex.en: In academic writing, precise adjectives help readers understand complex ideas without relying on lengthy explanations.
ex.zh: 在学术写作中，准确的形容词有助于读者理解复杂概念，而无需依赖冗长的解释。

tip: 形容词常放在名词前或系动词后，如a cold day。

senses.en: The power to direct or limit someone or something.
To direct, manage, or limit someone or something.
A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
ex.zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。

ex.en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。

tip: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

senses.en: Involving two or more countries.
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

senses.en: A person responsible for running a business, team, or department.

ex.en: The manager helped a new employee arrange the shelves.
ex.zh: 经理帮一位新员工整理了货架。

ex.en: An effective manager encourages open communication and ensures that employees have sufficient resources to complete their tasks.
ex.zh: 高效的管理者鼓励开放沟通，并确保员工有充足的资源完成任务。

tip: manager指管理者；management可指管理工作或管理层。

senses.en: The vast salt water covering much of Earth's surface.

ex.en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
ex.zh: 我们看着太阳从海面上升起。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。

tip: ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。

senses.en: including everything, or complete in degree
the amount obtained by adding everything together
to reach a particular amount or add amounts together

ex.en: The total cost includes breakfast and a bus ticket.
ex.zh: 总费用包含早餐和一张公交车票。

ex.en: Improving home insulation can reduce total energy consumption while making housing more comfortable throughout the year.
ex.zh: 改善住宅隔热性能可以减少能源总消耗，同时让住房全年都更加舒适。

tip: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.en: To decide that something planned will not happen.
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 由于下大雨，我们不得不取消野餐。

ex.en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
ex.zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。

tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

senses.en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.
