ex.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
ex.zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
ex.zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。

tip: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

senses.en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area
To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted

ex.en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时，肚子开始咕咕叫。

ex.en: Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.
ex.zh: 规律进餐可能有助于预防胃部不适，并帮助学生养成健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition

senses.zh: 成功的人或事物；受益者
senses.en: someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation

ex.en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
ex.zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。

ex.en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
ex.zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。

tip: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

ex.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
ex.zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。

ex.en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
ex.zh: 在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。

tip: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

senses.en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role.
Something that someone does.
A law formally approved by a legislative body.

ex.en: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
ex.zh: 我们必须赶快采取行动，免得厨房水槽里的水溢出来。

ex.en: Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。

tip: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

senses.en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.

ex.en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
ex.zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。

ex.en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。

tip: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

senses.en: in or towards the central business area of a city
located in the central business area of a city
the central business area of a city

ex.en: We took the bus downtown to buy new shoes.
ex.zh: 我们乘公交车去市中心买新鞋。

ex.en: Improved public transport can encourage more residents to shop downtown rather than drive to suburban shopping centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以鼓励更多居民到市中心购物，而不是开车前往郊区购物中心。

tip: 主要用于美式英语；作副词时前面不加to。

senses.zh: 令人惊讶的；出乎意料的
senses.en: unexpected and causing a feeling of surprise

ex.en: The tiny bakery offers a surprising variety of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店的新鲜面包种类多得令人惊讶。

ex.en: The survey revealed a surprising decline in car ownership among young adults living in major cities.
ex.zh: 调查显示，大城市年轻人的汽车拥有率出现了出人意料的下降。

tip: surprising形容事物；surprised形容人的感受。

senses.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
To transport goods by truck.

ex.en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一辆卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。

ex.en: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
ex.zh: 用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。

tip: truck常用于美式英语，英式英语常用lorry。

senses.en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance.
To move a hand or object repeatedly as a signal.
A sudden increase or spread of something.

ex.en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
ex.zh: 一个大浪冲过了我们的小沙堡。

ex.en: Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.
ex.zh: 沿海湿地能够吸收波浪能量，帮助保护附近居民区免受侵蚀和风暴破坏。

tip: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。

senses.en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them.
Touching or supported by a surface.
For protection from something harmful or unwanted.

ex.en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。

ex.en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。

tip: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

senses.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time
A particular way of doing something
Make or shape something, often using simple materials

ex.en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
ex.zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。

ex.en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
ex.zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。

tip: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

senses.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes
made of plastic
able to be shaped or changed easily

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
ex.zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。

ex.en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
ex.zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

senses.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.
The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables.
Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
ex.zh: 在泳池游泳后，我觉得皮肤很干。

ex.en: Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.
ex.zh: 保护皮肤免受过度日晒，可以降低日后出现严重健康问题的风险。

tip: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

senses.en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground.
A weakness or missing part in a plan or argument.

ex.en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。

ex.en: The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.
ex.zh: 安全围栏上发现了一个破洞，促使居民要求紧急维修。

tip: hole指洞；whole指完整的，两词同音。

senses.en: Rest with your body or an object in a flat position
Say something you know is not true
Something untrue that someone says deliberately

ex.en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
ex.zh: 我喜欢午饭后躺在草地上。

ex.en: Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.
ex.zh: 就环保效益撒谎的广告会损害公众信任，并阻碍真正可持续的购买决策。

tip: 躺：lie–lay–lain；说谎：lie–lied–lied。

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

senses.en: To like or choose something more than another option.

ex.en: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，比起蛋糕，我更喜欢吃新鲜水果。

ex.en: Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.
ex.zh: 一些员工更喜欢居家办公，因为这样更灵活，也免去了每天通勤。

tip: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

ex.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
ex.zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

senses.en: In the direction of someone or something
In relation to someone or something, especially attitudes or behaviour
Helping to achieve or pay for something

ex.en: The puppy ran toward me with a muddy ball.
ex.zh: 小狗叼着一个沾满泥的球向我跑来。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is an important step toward reducing traffic congestion and improving urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通是缓解交通拥堵、改善城市空气质量的重要一步。

tip: toward与towards同义；前者美式更常用。

senses.en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals.
A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes.
To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.

ex.en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
ex.zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。

ex.en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
ex.zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。

tip: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

senses.en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine
Letters and words produced on paper by printing
A mark left by something pressed against a surface

ex.en: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
ex.zh: 你能把这份食谱打印两份吗？

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。

tip: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

senses.en: A mobile phone with internet access and computer-like functions.

ex.en: I used my smartphone to photograph the evening sky.
ex.zh: 我用智能手机拍下了傍晚的天空。

ex.en: Although smartphones provide convenient access to information, excessive use may disrupt sleep and reduce concentration.
ex.zh: 虽然智能手机让获取信息更加方便，但过度使用可能干扰睡眠并降低专注力。

tip: smartphone是可数名词，通常写成一个词。

senses.en: unwilling to work or make an effort
relaxed and involving little activity

ex.en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我懒得做饭。

ex.en: Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.
ex.zh: 不应一概认为做作业有困难的学生懒惰，因为这可能涉及学习障碍。

tip: lazy afternoon指悠闲的午后，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or speaking to people
to move away suddenly in fear, especially of a horse

ex.en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
ex.zh: 莉娜刚加入这个新社团时有些害羞。

ex.en: Small group discussions can help shy students gain confidence before speaking in front of the whole class.
ex.zh: 小组讨论可以帮助害羞的学生建立信心，为在全班面前发言做准备。

tip: shy away from后接名词或动名词，表示回避。

senses.en: living or growing naturally, without human care
showing strong excitement or uncontrolled behaviour
natural places where animals and plants live freely

ex.en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
ex.zh: 我们看见野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。

ex.en: Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。

tip: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。

senses.en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight.
To prevent others from knowing or noticing something.
The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.

ex.en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
ex.zh: 我们把生日礼物藏在了床底下。

ex.en: Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.
ex.zh: 企业不应隐瞒其产品或生产流程所涉及的环境风险信息。

tip: 过去式hid，过去分词hidden；hide from意为躲避。

senses.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress
to cause someone emotional suffering

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
ex.zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。

ex.en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能减轻长时间久坐的办公室职员的背痛。

tip: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

senses.en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration.
To indicate that something may be true.

ex.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

senses.en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials
The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it

ex.en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我提着一篮新鲜苹果走进厨房。

ex.en: Providing reusable shopping baskets can encourage customers to reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bags.
ex.zh: 提供可重复使用的购物篮可以鼓励顾客减少对一次性塑料袋的依赖。

tip: a basket of apples指一篮苹果；篮子数量用baskets。

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

ex.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。

ex.en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。

tip: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。

senses.en: unable to happen, exist, or be done
extremely difficult to deal with or satisfy

ex.en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
ex.zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。

tip: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

senses.en: to move over ice or ground wearing special wheeled or bladed shoes
a boot with a blade or wheels for moving smoothly

ex.en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。

ex.en: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
ex.zh: 供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。

tip: 鞋子常用复数skates；go skating表示去滑冰。

senses.en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.

ex.en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
ex.zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。

ex.en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
ex.zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。

tip: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
ex.zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。

ex.en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
ex.zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

senses.en: A flat board used to support or store things.
A broad, relatively flat area of rock or seabed.

ex.en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
ex.zh: 把干净杯子放在水槽上方的架子上。

ex.en: Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.
ex.zh: 把健康零食摆在与视线齐平的货架上，可能促使购物者选择更有营养的食品。

tip: 复数是shelves；shelf life指保质期。

senses.en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way.
To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.

ex.en: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
ex.zh: 孩子们为轮到谁玩而争吵。

ex.en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
ex.zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。

tip: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

senses.en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action
used to emphasize that we do something, not others

ex.en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
ex.zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。

ex.en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
ex.zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。

tip: by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

senses.en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement
a state of quietness or freedom from worry

ex.en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。

ex.en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
ex.zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。

tip: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

senses.en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures
to burst or make a short, sharp sound
to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly

ex.en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
ex.zh: 我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。

ex.en: Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.
ex.zh: 流行音乐可以让年轻听众了解其他文化，尤其是在艺人融合不同音乐传统时。

tip: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

senses.en: the final part of a story, event, or activity
a final word part that often shows grammatical information

ex.en: The film had a surprisingly cheerful ending for everyone.
ex.zh: 这部电影的结局出人意料，所有人都皆大欢喜。

ex.en: An ambiguous ending can encourage readers to question their assumptions and consider alternative interpretations of a novel.
ex.zh: 含义不明确的结局可以促使读者质疑自己的假设，并考虑对小说的其他解读。

tip: 故事结局用ending；at the end表示在末尾。

senses.en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.
Food given to farm animals.
A regularly updated stream of online content.

ex.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
ex.zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。

ex.en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

senses.en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do.
Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically.
An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.

ex.en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
ex.zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。

ex.en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。

tip: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

senses.en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles.
A business where vehicles are repaired and serviced.

ex.en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
ex.zh: 我们把汽车和自行车停在车库里。

ex.en: Converting an unused garage into living space can provide additional accommodation without requiring new land.
ex.zh: 将闲置车库改成居住空间，可以在不占用新土地的情况下增加住房。

tip: 英式英语也常用 garage 指汽车修理厂。

senses.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

ex.en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。

ex.en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
ex.zh: 孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。

tip: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。

senses.en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times.
Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.

ex.en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓有一间新式厨房，窗户很大。

ex.en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。

tip: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

senses.en: To give someone something they need or make it available.
To support someone financially by supplying what they need.

ex.en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
ex.zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。

tip: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

senses.en: In the direction of someone or something.
In relation to someone or something, especially in attitude.
Helping to achieve a goal or pay for something.

ex.en: The puppy ran towards me with its tail wagging.
ex.zh: 小狗摇着尾巴朝我跑来。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is an important step towards reducing air pollution in cities.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通是减少城市空气污染的重要一步。

tip: towards与toward意思相同；前者英式更常用。

senses.en: A chart of dates or a schedule of events.
A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。

tip: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

senses.en: The amount of space between two places or things
A lack of emotional closeness between people
To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views

ex.en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
ex.zh: 从我们家到学校的距离很短。

ex.en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
ex.zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。

tip: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

senses.en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall.
An airport area where passengers board a plane.

ex.en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
ex.zh: 她关上花园的门，免得狗跑出去。

ex.en: Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.
ex.zh: 机场应提供清晰的指引，让乘客无需过度紧张就能找到登机口。

tip: gate多指围墙或栅栏上的门；房间的门通常用door。

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound
to contact someone by telephone

ex.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
ex.zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。

ex.en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
ex.zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。

tip: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

senses.en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things.
The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.

ex.en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
ex.zh: 我们骑车上学，为保护环境出一份力。

ex.en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
ex.zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。

tip: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

senses.en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place.
Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.

ex.en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落后，在这条狭窄的街道上停车很困难。

ex.en: Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.
ex.zh: 减少市中心的免费停车位可能促使通勤者更频繁地使用公共交通。

tip: 名词通常不可数；一个停车位说a parking space。

senses.en: The language spoken in Portugal, Brazil, and several other countries
Relating to Portugal, its people, or their language
The people of Portugal, considered as a group

ex.en: My neighbour speaks Portuguese with her family at home.
ex.zh: 我的邻居在家和家人说葡萄牙语。

ex.en: Learning Portuguese can help students access a wider range of literature and international career opportunities.
ex.zh: 学习葡萄牙语能帮助学生接触更广泛的文学作品，并获得国际就业机会。

tip: 首字母大写；单个葡萄牙人用a Portuguese person。

senses.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
ex.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

ex.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
ex.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

tip: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

senses.en: Learning and practice that develop skills for a particular activity.
Physical exercise and practice to prepare for sport.

ex.en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
ex.zh: 培训第一天，我就参与了为顾客提供帮助的工作。

ex.en: Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.
ex.zh: 定期职业培训有助于员工适应技术变化，并改善他们的长期职业前景。

tip: 通常不可数；一次培训可说a training session。

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex.en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
ex.zh: 他滑冰时摔断了手腕的一块骨头。

ex.en: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律的负重运动有助于保持骨骼强度，并能降低老年人骨折的风险。

tip: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。

senses.en: below something else in position, level, or amount
to move something down or reduce its level

ex.en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
ex.zh: 把重碗放在下面那层架子上。

ex.en: Governments can lower transport costs by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling routes.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资可靠的公交服务和安全的自行车道来降低交通成本。

tip: lower作动词通常接宾语；表示物价下降也可不及物。

senses.en: a large building or complex containing many shops

ex.en: We spent the rainy afternoon browsing in the mall.
ex.zh: 下雨的下午，我们一直在购物中心闲逛。

ex.en: A new shopping mall may create jobs, but it can also threaten small independent retailers.
ex.zh: 新的购物中心可能创造就业机会，但也可能威胁独立小零售商的生存。

tip: mall常用于美式英语；英式常说shopping centre。

senses.en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders
a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle

ex.en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
ex.zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
ex.zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。

tip: neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。

senses.en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people.
To care for someone who is ill or injured.

ex.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。

ex.en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。

tip: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

senses.en: An urban railway system that runs mainly underground.
A passage allowing people to walk beneath a road.

ex.en: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

ex.en: Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 扩建地铁网络可以缓解交通拥堵，前提是当地居民能够负担票价并方便地使用服务。

tip: 美式指地铁；英式常指地下人行通道。

senses.en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg
the enclosed storage space at the back of a car
to start a computer and load its operating system

ex.en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
ex.zh: 我的靴子让双脚在雨中保持干爽。

ex.en: Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.
ex.zh: 防护靴对建筑工人至关重要，因为它们能降低脚部严重受伤的风险。

tip: 汽车后备箱英式说boot，美式说trunk。

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: 协会或组织的书记；干事
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。

ex.en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。

tip: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

senses.en: A set of steps connecting different levels of a building.

ex.en: We carried the heavy suitcase up the narrow stairs.
ex.zh: 我们把沉重的行李箱沿着狭窄的楼梯搬了上去。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide lifts alongside stairs to ensure equal access for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应在楼梯之外配备电梯，确保行动不便者也能平等使用。

tip: stairs是复数，谓语用复数；一段楼梯用a flight of stairs。

senses.en: a device used for cooking food or heating a room

ex.en: A pot of soup is bubbling on the stove.
ex.zh: 一锅汤正在炉灶上咕嘟咕嘟地煮着。

ex.en: Replacing traditional indoor stoves with cleaner models can reduce household air pollution and improve respiratory health.
ex.zh: 用更清洁的炉具替换传统室内炉灶，可以减少家庭空气污染并改善呼吸系统健康。

tip: stove用于烹饪或取暖；oven专指烤箱。

senses.en: Someone who designs or builds machines, structures, or technical systems.
To design something technical or skilfully arrange an outcome.

ex.en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
ex.zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。

ex.en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
ex.zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。

tip: engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。

senses.en: A young dog.

ex.en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
ex.zh: 小狗钻进我的空鞋子里睡着了。

ex.en: Adopting a puppy requires a long-term commitment to training, exercise, and regular veterinary care.
ex.zh: 领养幼犬意味着要长期承担训练、运动和定期兽医护理的责任。

tip: 复数为puppies；通常专指幼犬。

senses.en: A length of time or a stage in history.
A scheduled length of time for a school lesson.
The monthly flow of blood from the uterus.

ex.en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。

ex.en: A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
ex.zh: 长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。

tip: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。

senses.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

ex.en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
ex.zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。

ex.en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
ex.zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。

tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

senses.en: To become visible or come into view.
To seem to be a certain way.
To take part in a performance or attend court formally.

ex.en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
ex.zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: a person's working life, often within a particular profession
to move very fast in a way that seems uncontrolled

ex.en: My sister hopes to build a career in nursing.
ex.zh: 我姐姐希望在护理行业发展事业。

ex.en: Access to affordable training enables adults to change career and adapt to a rapidly evolving labour market.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的培训，使成年人能够转行并适应快速变化的劳动力市场。

tip: career侧重长期职业发展，job指具体工作。

senses.en: To move someone or something to a higher position.
A machine carrying people or goods between floors.
A ride in someone else's vehicle.

ex.en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子抬到架子上吗？

ex.en: Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 在较老的公共建筑中安装电梯，可以方便轮椅使用者和行动不便的人进出。

tip: 电梯英式用lift，美式用elevator。

senses.en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed.
A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.

ex.en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
ex.zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。

ex.en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
ex.zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。

tip: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。

senses.en: The supreme being worshipped in religions believing in one god.

ex.en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
ex.zh: 我祖母在家每次用餐前都会感谢上帝。

ex.en: Belief in God can influence people's values, charitable activities, and responses to difficult circumstances.
ex.zh: 对上帝的信仰可能影响人们的价值观、慈善活动及应对困境的方式。

tip: 指唯一的神用God，通常不加冠词；泛指神用god。

senses.en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region
the activity or system of controlling a country

ex.en: The government plans to build a new hospital nearby.
ex.zh: 政府计划在附近建一所新医院。

ex.en: Local government plays a crucial role in providing affordable housing and maintaining essential public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府在提供可负担住房和维持基本公共服务方面发挥着关键作用。

tip: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: A portable computer with a screen that folds over its keyboard.

ex.en: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
ex.zh: 我的笔记本电脑正好能放进背包前面的隔层。

ex.en: Providing every student with a laptop may improve access to learning resources, but technical support remains essential.
ex.zh: 为每位学生配备笔记本电脑或许能改善学习资源的获取，但技术支持仍然必不可少。

tip: laptop是便携电脑；desktop通常指台式电脑。

senses.en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.

ex.en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.
ex.zh: 房产业主应维护其建筑，确保租户和附近居民的安全。

tip: 表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。

senses.en: To give out or reflect light.
To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth.
Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。

tip: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

senses.en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended.
Having achieved wealth, respect, or a good position.

ex.en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。

ex.en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
ex.zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。

tip: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

senses.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
ex.zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

senses.en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet
a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast

ex.en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
ex.zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。

ex.en: Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 用新鲜水果代替高糖饼干，可以帮助儿童逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

senses.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement
to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence
a quick movement back and forth

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

senses.en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area

ex.en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。

ex.en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。

tip: 复数可用stadiums或stadia，前者更常见。

senses.en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns

ex.en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
ex.zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。

ex.en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
ex.zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。

tip: 点蜡烛用light；吹灭用blow out。

senses.en: a paper or digital record containing information
record information about something in writing, photographs, or other forms

ex.en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
ex.zh: 合上笔记本电脑之前，请保存文档。

ex.en: Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.
ex.zh: 研究人员应记录当地野生生物的变化，以评估城市开发对环境的影响。

tip: 动词末尾读/ment/，名词末尾读/mənt/。

senses.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems
past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased

ex.en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
ex.zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。

ex.en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
ex.zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。

tip: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

senses.en: To achieve what you are trying to do.
To take someone's position after they leave it.

ex.en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
ex.zh: 尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。

ex.en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
ex.zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。

tip: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

senses.en: the head of state in a country without a monarch
the person leading an organisation, company, club, or university

ex.en: The president waved to the crowd outside the palace.
ex.zh: 总统向宫殿外的人群挥手致意。

ex.en: The newly elected president promised to improve public healthcare and expand access to affordable education.
ex.zh: 新当选的总统承诺改善公共医疗，并扩大可负担教育的覆盖范围。

tip: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。

senses.en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.

ex.en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
ex.zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。

ex.en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
ex.zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。

tip: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

senses.en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.

ex.en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
ex.zh: 有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？

ex.en: Public libraries should be accessible to anybody who wishes to learn, regardless of their income or background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向所有想学习的人开放，不论其收入或背景如何。

tip: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

senses.en: A bag carried on the back using two shoulder straps.
To travel carrying your belongings in a backpack.

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in my backpack.
ex.zh: 我把午餐和外套装进了双肩背包。

ex.en: Young adults often backpack through rural regions, supporting small businesses and learning about local traditions.
ex.zh: 年轻人常背包穿行于乡村地区，支持小型商家并了解当地传统。

tip: 指双肩背包；英式英语也常用rucksack。

senses.en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown
not present where something should be

ex.en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们发现那只找不到的小猫正在沙发后面睡觉。

ex.en: Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.
ex.zh: 数据缺失会削弱研究结果的可靠性，并导致政策制定者得出不准确的结论。

tip: missing作形容词表不见或缺失；be missing from表缺少。

senses.en: to say firmly that you will do something
a firm statement that you will do something
signs that someone or something may succeed

ex.en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
ex.zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。

ex.en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。

tip: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

senses.en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again
Work done to restore something damaged or broken
To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right

ex.en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
ex.zh: 你能修好我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗？

ex.en: Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.
ex.zh: 鼓励消费者维修而非更换家用电器，可以显著减少电子垃圾。

tip: 具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。

senses.en: meat from cattle, eaten as food

ex.en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
ex.zh: 我们把牛肉和胡萝卜、土豆一起慢炖。

ex.en: Reducing beef consumption could lower greenhouse gas emissions because raising cattle requires substantial land and resources.
ex.zh: 减少牛肉消费可能降低温室气体排放，因为养牛需要大量土地和资源。

tip: 表示食物时通常不可数：some beef，不用a beef。

senses.en: staying outdoors in a tent, usually for a holiday

ex.en: We are going camping by the river this weekend.
ex.zh: 这个周末我们要去河边露营。

ex.en: Camping can encourage greater appreciation of nature, provided visitors avoid disturbing wildlife and take their rubbish home.
ex.zh: 露营能增进人们对自然的欣赏，前提是游客不打扰野生动物，并把垃圾带走。

tip: 活动名词camping不可数；去露营说go camping。

senses.en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level.
To get up from sitting or lying down.
An increase in amount, level, or value.

ex.en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
ex.zh: 我书桌旁的暖气上方，热空气向上升腾。

ex.en: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。

tip: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

senses.en: From or relating to a country other than your own.
Present where it does not naturally belong.
Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。

ex.en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
ex.zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

tip: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

senses.en: A utensil with a small bowl for eating or serving.
To move or serve food using a spoon.

ex.en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
ex.zh: 教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。

tip: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

senses.en: the skill or power needed to do something

ex.en: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
ex.zh: 她修自行车的本领让朋友们都很佩服。

ex.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air
to make thoughts or judgment less clear

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

tip: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
ex.zh: 他用硬纸板做了一座桥的模型。

ex.en: Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用计算机模型预测气温上升可能如何影响区域供水。

tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

senses.en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape
gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh
not strict or severe enough

ex.en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。

ex.en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。

tip: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。

senses.en: to secure something so it cannot open, move, or be accessed
a device that keeps something shut until opened correctly
a small section of someone's hair

ex.en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
ex.zh: 上楼前请把后门锁好。

ex.en: Employees should lock their computers whenever they leave their desks to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information.
ex.zh: 员工离开办公桌时应锁定电脑，以防机密信息被未经授权的人查看。

tip: lock是锁上，unlock是解锁；两者不可混用。

senses.en: not any of the people or things being considered
not at all, used before certain comparative expressions

ex.en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
ex.zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。

ex.en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
ex.zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。

tip: none可独立用；修饰名词用no，如no books。

senses.en: Someone receiving medical care.
Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming annoyed.

ex.en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
ex.zh: 护士给病人端来了一杯水。

ex.en: Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.
ex.zh: 让患者讨论治疗方案可以增进信任，并改善健康结果。

tip: 作名词是“患者”；作形容词常接with。

senses.en: As stated or reported by someone or something
In a way determined by a rule or particular factor

ex.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this evening.
ex.zh: 据天气预报，今晚会下雨。

ex.en: Public funding should be distributed according to local needs rather than the political influence of individual regions.
ex.zh: 公共资金应按当地需求分配，而不应取决于各地区的政治影响力。

tip: 通常用according to，不单独作形容词。

senses.en: At a later time, following an event.

ex.en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。

ex.en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
ex.zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。

tip: 是副词，后面不直接接宾语；after可接宾语。

senses.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells
a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance

ex.en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
ex.zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

ex.en: Strict gun storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety within local communities.
ex.zh: 严格的枪支存放规定有助于预防事故，提高当地社区的安全水平。

tip: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

ex.en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
ex.zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。

ex.en: In many schools, a bell marks the beginning and end of each lesson.
ex.zh: 在许多学校，铃声标志着每节课的开始和结束。

tip: ring a bell也可表示“听着耳熟；似曾相识”。

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。

ex.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
ex.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

senses.en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity.
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: Our electric kettle boils water in two minutes.
ex.zh: 我们的电水壶两分钟就能把水烧开。

ex.en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
ex.zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。

tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

senses.en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing
the process of saving sounds, images, or information

ex.en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐时，我们听了一段鸟鸣录音。

ex.en: Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.
ex.zh: 能够获取讲座录像，让学生可以按自己的节奏复习难懂的概念。

tip: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event
the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
ex.zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。

tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder
to move somewhere angrily and forcefully
a sudden wave of strong public anger or criticism

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。

tip: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

senses.en: A large group of people gathered in one place.
To gather closely together or fill a place with people.

ex.en: A crowd gathered around the musicians in the square.
ex.zh: 一群人聚在广场上的乐手周围。

ex.en: Large crowds at popular attractions can damage historic sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.
ex.zh: 热门景点的大量游客可能破坏历史遗址，除非游客数量得到妥善管理。

tip: a crowd of后接复数名词；crowded表示拥挤的。

senses.en: a division of an organisation responsible for a particular subject
an area of a shop selling a particular type of product

ex.en: Please ask our sales department about the delivery date.
ex.zh: 请向我们的销售部门询问送货日期。

ex.en: Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.
ex.zh: 大学各系应定期审查课程，确保课程反映相关领域的发展。

tip: 大学的系可用department；学院通常用faculty或school。

senses.en: A container with a handle and spout for boiling water.

ex.en: Put the kettle on while I find the cups.
ex.zh: 你先烧水，我来找杯子。

ex.en: Boiling only the water needed in a kettle can reduce household electricity consumption over time.
ex.zh: 每次只烧所需的水，长期下来可以减少家庭用电量。

tip: kettle 用来烧水，teapot 用来泡茶。

senses.en: a room with toilets in a public place

ex.en: I stopped at the restroom before boarding the bus.
ex.zh: 上公交车前，我去了一趟洗手间。

ex.en: Providing a clean public restroom near busy transport hubs improves comfort for commuters and tourists alike.
ex.zh: 在繁忙的交通枢纽附近提供干净的公共洗手间，能让通勤者和游客都更加舒适。

tip: 美式英语中指公共厕所，不是普通的休息室。

senses.en: To give food or drink, or assist customers.
To work for people, an organisation, or your country.
To be used for a particular purpose.

ex.en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。

ex.en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。

tip: serve as后接角色或用途；serve for不这样用。

senses.en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body.
A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.

ex.en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只黄色蝴蝶轻轻落在我的袖子上。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。

tip: 复数为butterflies；蝶泳义通常不可数。

senses.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.
Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

senses.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building
a large room or building used for public gatherings
a building where university students live

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
ex.zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。

ex.en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
ex.zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。

tip: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

senses.en: a sweet, sticky food made by bees

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
ex.zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。

tip: 表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。

senses.en: decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces

ex.en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
ex.zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly want assurance that the materials used in jewelry are sourced responsibly and without environmental damage.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越希望得到保证：首饰所用材料的来源负责任，且不损害环境。

tip: 美式拼写，英式为jewellery；不可数，用piece计件。

senses.en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice
having a pale yellow colour

ex.en: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
ex.zh: 我把半个柠檬的汁挤在烤鱼上。

ex.en: Adding lemon juice to meals can improve flavour without increasing the amount of salt consumed.
ex.zh: 在餐食中加入柠檬汁可以增添风味，而不增加盐的摄入量。

tip: 整个柠檬可数；lemon juice中的juice不可数。

senses.en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about.
Believing you are better or more important than others.

ex.en: He felt proud of the cake he baked himself.
ex.zh: 他为自己亲手烤出的蛋糕感到自豪。

ex.en: Residents are often proud of their cultural heritage and support efforts to preserve historic buildings.
ex.zh: 居民往往为自己的文化遗产感到自豪，并支持保护历史建筑的行动。

tip: be proud of后接名词或动名词，表示为……自豪。

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。

ex.en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。

tip: solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

senses.en: an electrical appliance that heats bread until crisp and brown

ex.en: Two slices of bread popped out of the toaster.
ex.zh: 两片面包从烤面包机里弹了出来。

ex.en: Small appliances such as toasters should be designed for easy repair rather than frequent replacement.
ex.zh: 烤面包机等小型电器的设计应便于维修，而不是让人频繁更换。

tip: toaster是电器；toast指烤面包时不可数。

senses.en: Someone paid to work for a person or organisation.

ex.en: A new employee showed me around the bakery.
ex.zh: 一位新员工带我参观了面包店。

ex.en: Employers should provide every employee with appropriate training to maintain a safe and productive workplace.
ex.zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当培训，以保持工作场所的安全和高效。

tip: employee是雇员，employer是雇主。

senses.en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.

ex.en: I finished my history essay just before dinner.
ex.zh: 我刚好在晚饭前写完了历史课论文。

ex.en: Writing an essay encourages students to organise their ideas and support arguments with relevant evidence.
ex.zh: 撰写论说文能促使学生整理思路，并用相关证据支持论点。

tip: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。

senses.en: one of two earpieces worn over the ears for listening

ex.en: I wear headphones so my music won't disturb anyone.
ex.zh: 我戴着耳机听音乐，这样就不会打扰别人。

ex.en: Students using headphones in shared study spaces should keep the volume low to protect their hearing.
ex.zh: 在公共学习空间使用耳机的学生应保持较低音量，以保护听力。

tip: 日常说耳机通常用复数headphones，一副用a pair of。

senses.en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something
to value something very highly

ex.en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
ex.zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。

ex.en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。

tip: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

senses.en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger
to cut something into thin, flat pieces
a share or portion of something

ex.en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
ex.zh: 她在我的茶里放了一片柠檬。

ex.en: Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.
ex.zh: 住房开支占据家庭收入的很大一部分，使许多家庭几乎没有钱用于休闲。

tip: slice强调切出的片；piece泛指一块或一件。

senses.en: happening or done most often in a particular situation

ex.en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
ex.zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。

ex.en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 对科技行业的一些员工来说，居家办公已成为常规安排。

tip: as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。

senses.en: a place where bread and cakes are made or sold

ex.en: The bakery near our house sells warm bread every morning.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的面包店每天早上都卖热乎乎的面包。

ex.en: Small businesses such as bakeries provide local employment and help maintain vibrant neighbourhood shopping areas.
ex.zh: 面包店等小企业提供本地就业岗位，也有助于保持社区商业区的活力。

tip: bakery指店铺或制作场所；烘焙食品用baked goods。

senses.en: A hoofed animal, often with horns, kept for milk or meat.

ex.en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
ex.zh: 一只好奇的山羊把头探出了围栏。

ex.en: Raising goats can provide rural families with a reliable source of milk and additional income.
ex.zh: 饲养山羊可以为农村家庭提供稳定的奶源和额外收入。

tip: goat是山羊，sheep是绵羊；替罪羊用scapegoat。

senses.en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone.
Friendly wishes expressed on a special occasion.

ex.en: She gave us a cheerful greeting at the door.
ex.zh: 她在门口愉快地向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Learning local greeting customs can help international students build relationships and avoid misunderstandings in their new environment.
ex.zh: 了解当地的问候习俗可以帮助国际学生建立人际关系，避免在新环境中产生误解。

tip: 表示节日祝福常用复数greetings，如birthday greetings。

senses.en: A team sport using sticks to hit a ball or puck

ex.en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在学校运动场练习了曲棍球。

ex.en: Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.
ex.zh: 让曲棍球设施更便于使用，可以鼓励更多年轻人参加团队运动。

tip: 英国通常指草地曲棍球；美国通常指冰球。

senses.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

ex.en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
ex.zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。

ex.en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
ex.zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

senses.en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
A raised surface where people can stand or perform.
A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.

ex.en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
ex.zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。

ex.en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。

tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
ex.zh: 一只小小的青蛙从花盆里跳了出来。

ex.en: Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 即使日常习惯的微小改变，长期下来也能减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。

senses.en: not sleeping
to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

ex.en: I was still awake when the rain finally stopped.
ex.zh: 雨终于停下时，我还醒着。

ex.en: Students who stay awake late at night may struggle to concentrate during lessons the following morning.
ex.zh: 熬夜不睡的学生第二天上午上课时可能难以集中注意力。

tip: 形容词通常作表语；动词变化为awoke、awoken。

senses.en: To take and use something with permission, then return it.
To use an idea or word from another source.

ex.en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
ex.zh: 我能借用一下你的伞，明天早上还吗？

ex.en: Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.
ex.zh: 随着国际贸易和文化交流拉近各群体的距离，许多语言会从其他语言中引入词汇。

tip: borrow是借入，lend是借出；向某人借用from。

senses.en: an appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen

ex.en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
ex.zh: 把冰激凌放回冷冻室。

ex.en: Using a freezer allows households to store seasonal produce longer and reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 使用冷冻柜能让家庭更长时间地储存时令农产品，减少食物浪费。

tip: freezer用于冷冻；fridge主要用于冷藏。

senses.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately
an affectionate touch made with the lips

ex.en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。

ex.en: In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，亲吻脸颊是亲密朋友之间常见的问候方式。

tip: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。

senses.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.
To direct or control a business, team, or activity.
To cope with a situation despite difficulties or limited resources.

ex.en: I managed to carry all the bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 我总算把所有袋子都提上了楼。

ex.en: Many students manage to balance academic demands with paid employment by planning their weekly schedules carefully.
ex.zh: 许多学生通过仔细安排每周日程，设法兼顾学业要求与有薪工作。

tip: manage to do表示成功做成，不只是尝试。

senses.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface
a score showing the quality of a student's work
to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work

ex.en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 你的湿杯子在桌上留下了一道印子。

ex.en: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。

tip: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

senses.en: a machine programmed to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。

ex.en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
ex.zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。

tip: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

senses.en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice.
A loud call or cry made with the voice.

ex.en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
ex.zh: 我们朝河对岸大喊，却没有人听见。

ex.en: In noisy classrooms, teachers may need to shout, which can strain their voices over time.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂的教室里，教师可能需要大声说话，长期如此会损伤嗓音。

tip: shout at常含生气意味；shout to重在让远处的人听见。

senses.en: The activity of growing and caring for plants in gardens.

ex.en: My grandmother enjoys gardening on cool spring mornings.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在凉爽的春日早晨打理花园。

ex.en: Community gardening can improve urban environments while helping residents develop stronger social connections.
ex.zh: 社区园艺既能改善城市环境，也能帮助居民建立更紧密的社会联系。

tip: 通常为不可数名词：do some gardening。

senses.en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it.
A special quality that makes something exciting or wonderful.
Having supernatural powers or used in performing tricks.

ex.en: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
ex.zh: 他表演魔术时，孩子们笑了起来。

ex.en: Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.
ex.zh: 虽然技术能够改善教育，但它不是解决学校所有问题的神奇办法。

tip: magic 多指魔法或魔术；magical 也可形容美妙体验。

senses.en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it.
A hard mass that forms inside an organ.
The hard central part of some fruits containing the seed.

ex.en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
ex.zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。

ex.en: Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
ex.zh: 使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。

tip: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

senses.en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger
Willingness to explore unfamiliar or exciting situations

ex.en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
ex.zh: 天黑后，我们的露营之旅变成了一次冒险。

ex.en: Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。

tip: adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。

senses.en: salted or smoked pork, usually served in thin slices

ex.en: He cooked bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天，他做了培根和鸡蛋当早餐。

ex.en: Reducing consumption of processed meat, including bacon, is often recommended as part of a healthier diet.
ex.zh: 减少包括培根在内的加工肉类摄入，常被建议作为更健康饮食的一部分。

tip: 通常不可数；一片培根用a slice of bacon。

senses.en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat
Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something
Avoid a difficult question, responsibility, or situation

ex.en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
ex.zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。

ex.en: Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.
ex.zh: 拥有健康池塘的城市公园全年都能为鸭子和其他野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。

senses.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

ex.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。

ex.en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
ex.zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。

tip: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。

senses.en: An electric oven that heats food using electromagnetic waves
To cook or heat food in a microwave oven
A short electromagnetic wave used for heating and communication

ex.en: I heated yesterday's soup in the microwave for lunch.
ex.zh: 我用微波炉热了昨天的汤，当作午餐。

ex.en: Using a microwave to reheat small portions can consume less energy than using a conventional oven.
ex.zh: 用微波炉加热少量食物，比使用普通烤箱可能更节能。

tip: 作动词可直接接食物：microwave the soup。

senses.en: One of the five separate parts at the foot's end
The part of a shoe or sock covering the toes

ex.en: There is a little sand stuck between my toes.
ex.zh: 我的脚趾缝里沾了一点沙子。

ex.en: Wearing shoes that restrict toe movement may affect balance and contribute to foot problems over time.
ex.zh: 穿限制脚趾活动的鞋子可能影响平衡，长此以往还可能导致足部问题。

tip: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。

senses.en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature
to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat
a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus

ex.en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
ex.zh: 把土豆煮到能轻松戳穿为止。

ex.en: Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.
ex.zh: 当洪水破坏当地供水并增加感染风险时，居民应将饮用水煮沸。

tip: boil指沸腾或煮沸；simmer指小火慢煮。

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

ex.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
ex.zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。

tip: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

senses.en: Someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

ex.en: My colleague brought homemade soup to the office today.
ex.zh: 我的同事今天把自制的汤带到了办公室。

ex.en: Sharing knowledge with colleagues can improve workplace efficiency and help new employees develop essential skills.
ex.zh: 与同事分享知识可以提高工作效率，并帮助新员工培养必要技能。

tip: colleague指同事，不一定是朋友或同级员工。

senses.en: not in or to any place

ex.en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
ex.zh: 拥挤的火车上没有地方可坐。

ex.en: Without affordable housing, some low-income families have nowhere to live despite having regular paid employment.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏可负担的住房，一些低收入家庭即使有固定工作，也无处居住。

tip: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。

senses.en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns
to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco
to produce smoke

ex.en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。

ex.en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
ex.zh: 森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。

tip: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

senses.en: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.

ex.en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
ex.zh: 她的行李箱太重，搬不上火车。

ex.en: Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.
ex.zh: 旅客可以通过减轻行李箱的重量，并尽量选择公共交通来减少交通排放。

tip: suitcase可数；统称行李的luggage不可数。

senses.en: No longer alive
No longer working, often because power has run out
Completely or exactly, used for emphasis

ex.en: We removed the dead flowers from the balcony pots.
ex.zh: 我们清除了阳台花盆里枯死的花。

ex.en: Leaving dead trees in forests can support biodiversity by providing habitats for insects and small animals.
ex.zh: 将枯树留在森林中能为昆虫和小动物提供栖息地，从而促进生物多样性。

tip: dead是状态，die是动作，death是名词。

senses.en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required
to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade
to stop working properly or become weaker

ex.en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
ex.zh: 尽管多加了一个鸡蛋，蛋糕还是没发起来。

ex.en: Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.
ex.zh: 地方政府若不提供清晰指导或便捷的收集服务，回收计划往往会失败。

tip: fail to do表示未能做；fail an exam表示考试不及格。

senses.en: extremely good or enjoyable
strange and imaginative, rather than realistic
extremely large in amount or degree

ex.en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
ex.zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。

ex.en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。

tip: 表示“极好的”偏口语；正式写作可用excellent。

senses.en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.

ex.en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
ex.zh: 我们挪开家具，腾出地方跳舞。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具既能降低家庭开支，也能减少原材料需求和废弃物。

tip: 不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。

senses.en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service
to send a letter or parcel through a postal service

ex.en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完早饭，邮件就到了。

ex.en: Although digital communication is widespread, many rural residents still depend on mail for essential documents.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信已很普及，许多农村居民仍依赖邮政收取重要文件。

tip: mail作“邮件”通常不可数；英式日常也常用post。

senses.en: located a short distance away
at or to a place a short distance away

ex.en: We bought fresh bread from a nearby bakery.
ex.zh: 我们从附近的一家面包店买了新鲜面包。

ex.en: Access to nearby parks encourages urban residents to exercise regularly and spend more time outdoors.
ex.zh: 附近有方便前往的公园，能鼓励城市居民经常锻炼，并增加户外活动时间。

tip: nearby不用作介词：说near the school，不说nearby the school。

senses.en: Cloth worn around the neck or head.

ex.en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。

ex.en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
ex.zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。

col: wrap a scarf around your neck
tip: 复数可用scarves或scarfs，前者更常见。

senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

ex.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

ex.en: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
ex.zh: 许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。

tip: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

senses.en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.
To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.

ex.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
ex.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。

ex.en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
ex.zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。

tip: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

senses.en: the way a person or animal acts
the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: The puppy's calm behavior surprised everyone at the park.
ex.zh: 这只小狗安静的表现让公园里的每个人都很惊讶。

ex.en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有实质性机会参与影响其社区的决策，以此鼓励负责任的行为。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

senses.en: A reproduction, or one example of a book or document
To reproduce something or imitate someone's actions
Written material prepared for publication or advertising

ex.en: Please keep a copy of the receipt at home.
ex.zh: 请在家里留一份收据副本。

ex.en: Students should learn to evaluate sources rather than simply copy information from websites into their assignments.
ex.zh: 学生应学会评估资料来源，而不是直接把网站信息抄进作业。

tip: 复数为copies；广告文案义的copy通常不可数。

senses.en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.

ex.en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
ex.zh: 开始锻炼前，她轻轻弯了弯膝盖。

ex.en: Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.
ex.zh: 经常进行低冲击运动可以增强膝关节周围的肌肉，帮助老年人保持行动能力。

tip: 词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。

senses.en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.

ex.en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
ex.zh: 我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。

ex.en: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
ex.zh: 当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。

tip: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。

senses.en: A thick, slightly sour food made by fermenting milk.

ex.en: I mix fresh berries into my yogurt every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上都往酸奶里拌入新鲜浆果。

ex.en: Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
ex.zh: 原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。

tip: 英式也常拼作yoghurt；通常不可数，一份可用a yogurt。

senses.en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body
family relationships or origins

ex.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
ex.zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。

tip: blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
ex.zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans.
Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.

ex.en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
ex.zh: 你周六上午来方便吗？

ex.en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
ex.zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。

tip: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

senses.en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers.
To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority.
A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.

ex.en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
ex.zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。

ex.en: Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.
ex.zh: 公共机构应安全存储机密文件，以防止未经授权的访问并保护公民的个人信息。

tip: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

senses.en: cooked in hot oil or fat

ex.en: We had fried eggs and toast for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们早餐吃了煎蛋和烤面包。

ex.en: Eating fried foods too frequently can increase calorie intake and make maintaining a healthy weight more difficult.
ex.zh: 过于频繁地吃油炸食品会增加热量摄入，使维持健康体重更加困难。

tip: fried是fry的过去式和过去分词，也作形容词；不限于油炸。

senses.en: A small folding case for carrying money and cards.

ex.en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。

ex.en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。

tip: wallet通常指放纸币和卡片的折叠式钱包。

senses.en: a large green-skinned fruit with juicy, usually red flesh

ex.en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
ex.zh: 在外面玩耍后，我们一起吃了一个冰凉的西瓜。

ex.en: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
ex.zh: 在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。

tip: 整个西瓜可数；指切开的瓜肉时常不可数。

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一枚银色硬币滚到了厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。

tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

senses.en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes.
A planned way of eating for health or weight control.
To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.

ex.en: My usual diet includes plenty of rice and vegetables.
ex.zh: 我的日常饮食中有大量米饭和蔬菜。

ex.en: A balanced diet can improve concentration and help students maintain their energy throughout the school day.
ex.zh: 均衡饮食能提高注意力，并帮助学生在整个上学期间保持精力。

tip: diet不一定指节食，也可指日常饮食。

senses.en: a portable computer with a flat touchscreen
a small solid dose of medicine swallowed whole
a flat stone or metal slab bearing an inscription

ex.en: I use my tablet to watch cooking videos.
ex.zh: 我用平板电脑看烹饪视频。

ex.en: Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.
ex.zh: 为每名学生配备平板电脑可能有助于获取学习资源，但教师仍需接受适当培训。

tip: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。

senses.en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.

ex.en: He showed me a drawing of his cat.
ex.zh: 他给我看了一幅他画的猫。

ex.en: Drawing can help children express emotions that they may find difficult to communicate through spoken language.
ex.zh: 绘画可以帮助儿童表达那些难以用口头语言传达的情感。

tip: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

ex.en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

senses.en: a request for someone to attend or join something

ex.en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
ex.zh: 我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。

ex.en: An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。

tip: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

senses.en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.

ex.en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
ex.zh: 我睡过了头，差点没赶上公交车。

ex.en: Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.
ex.zh: 受访居民中近一半支持扩建公共交通系统，而不是增建道路。

tip: nearly表示差一点达到；not nearly表示远远不。

senses.en: A particular period or step in a process.
A raised area where performers appear before an audience.
To organise and present a performance or public event.

ex.en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
ex.zh: 制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。

ex.en: Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
ex.zh: 在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。

tip: 表示阶段常用at a stage；表示在舞台上用on stage。

senses.en: someone who teaches people or animals particular skills
a shoe designed for sport or casual wear

ex.en: My trainer showed me how to lift weights safely.
ex.zh: 我的教练教我如何安全地举重。

ex.en: A qualified trainer can help employees develop practical skills that improve their performance at work.
ex.zh: 合格的培训师可以帮助员工培养实用技能，从而改善工作表现。

tip: 运动鞋英式常用trainers，美式常用sneakers。

senses.en: an appliance that keeps food and drinks cold

ex.en: Put the milk in the refrigerator before it spoils.
ex.zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱，免得变质。

ex.en: Replacing an old refrigerator with an efficient model can reduce household electricity consumption significantly.
ex.zh: 用节能型号替换旧冰箱，可以显著减少家庭用电量。

tip: 日常口语常用fridge；freezer专指冷冻柜或冷冻室。

senses.en: A thick slice of meat, especially beef, or fish.

ex.en: She served the steak with potatoes and green beans.
ex.zh: 她端上牛排，配了土豆和四季豆。

ex.en: Replacing beef steak with plant proteins occasionally can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
ex.zh: 偶尔用植物蛋白代替牛排，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。

tip: steak与stake同音；单说steak通常指牛排。

senses.en: to talk about something and exchange ideas
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们边吃晚饭边商量度假计划吧。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.

ex.en: Each user can choose a different colour for their profile.
ex.zh: 每位用户都可以为自己的个人资料选择不同的颜色。

ex.en: Software developers should consider the needs of every user, including people with limited technical skills.
ex.zh: 软件开发者应考虑每位用户的需求，包括技术能力有限的人。

tip: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

senses.en: A period of one hundred years.

ex.en: This bridge was built more than a century ago.
ex.zh: 这座桥建于一个多世纪以前。

ex.en: Over the past century, improvements in sanitation have contributed significantly to longer life expectancy worldwide.
ex.zh: 过去一个世纪里，卫生条件的改善对全球预期寿命的延长作出了重大贡献。

tip: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。

senses.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

ex.en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
ex.zh: 我们在悬崖后面发现了一片安静的海滩。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement.
No matter how much or to what degree.
In any way that someone chooses.

ex.en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
ex.zh: 这件夹克看起来很暖和，摸起来却出奇地薄。

ex.en: Online courses offer greater flexibility; however, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers.
ex.zh: 在线课程更加灵活；不过，有些学习者从与教师的直接互动中获益更多。

tip: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

senses.en: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it

ex.en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
ex.zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。

senses.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

ex.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
ex.zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。

ex.en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
ex.zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。

tip: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。

senses.en: A long seat designed for several people.
A sturdy table used for practical work.
