To keep a player out of a game.

ex.en: We shared a park bench and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们一起坐在公园长凳上看鸭子。

ex.en: Installing benches along pedestrian routes can make city centres more accessible to older residents and people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 沿步行路线设置长凳，可以让老年居民和行动不便者更方便地使用市中心空间。

tip: 长凳常无靠背，但并非一定如此；工作台也可用bench。

senses.en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls.
Growing upwards by attaching to or winding around supports.

ex.en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。

ex.en: Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过有人指导的攀岩活动，培养学生的自信、身体协调性和风险评估能力。

tip: climb中的b不发音；climbing plants指攀缘植物。

senses.en: an appliance used for cooking food

ex.en: The soup is bubbling in a pot on the cooker.
ex.zh: 锅里的汤正在炉灶上咕嘟咕嘟地冒泡。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient cooker with a modern appliance can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 用现代设备替换低效炉灶，长远来看可以减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 英式cooker指炉灶，美式常用stove；厨师是cook。

senses.en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space
a large hanging cloth that hides or reveals a stage

ex.en: She pulled the curtain aside to watch the rain.
ex.zh: 她把窗帘拉到一边，看着外面的雨。

ex.en: Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.
ex.zh: 在每扇窗户上安装厚窗帘，可以减少热量流失，提升老房屋的居住舒适度。

tip: draw the curtains可指拉开或拉上，需看语境。

senses.en: Untidy or dirty, with things scattered or out of place.
Complicated and difficult to deal with.

ex.en: His desk was messy after an afternoon of painting.
ex.zh: 画了一下午画后，他的书桌变得脏乱不堪。

ex.en: Without clear responsibilities, cooperation between public agencies can become messy and delay the delivery of essential services.
ex.zh: 如果没有明确的职责，公共机构之间的合作可能变得混乱，延误基本服务的提供。

tip: messy可指物品脏乱，也可指局面复杂难处理。

senses.en: forming words correctly using their written characters
the particular way a word is written

ex.en: My sister checks my spelling before I send emails.
ex.zh: 我发邮件前，姐姐会帮我检查拼写。

ex.en: Although digital tools can correct spelling, students still need to develop accurate writing skills.
ex.zh: 虽然数字工具可以纠正拼写，学生仍需培养准确书写的能力。

tip: 指拼写能力通常不可数；指具体拼法可数。

senses.en: A device that produces light, often on a table.

ex.en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她打开了床边的灯。

ex.en: Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
ex.zh: 对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。

tip: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。

senses.en: With a sound that has high volume.

ex.en: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛时，大家都大声欢呼。

ex.en: Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上大声说话的乘客会打扰他人，尤其是在清晨或深夜的行程中。

tip: loudly强调音量大；aloud强调出声而非默读。

senses.en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something.
Used with I or we to express future intentions formally.
Used in formal rules to state a requirement.

ex.en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
ex.zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？

ex.en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
ex.zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。

tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。

senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
ex.zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。

ex.en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
ex.zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。

tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

senses.en: to grow or make something stronger, larger, or more advanced
to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
ex.zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。

ex.en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

senses.en: An opening or place through which people enter.
The act of entering or the right to join.

ex.en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我在入口处与你碰面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
ex.zh: 大学应确保入学要求兼顾不同教育背景，同时维持适当的学术标准。

tip: 某处的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。

senses.en: agreement allowing someone to do something

ex.en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
ex.zh: 你得先征得姐姐同意，才能借她的自行车。

ex.en: Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
ex.zh: 研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。

tip: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

senses.en: a tall, narrow structure, standing alone or on a building
rise much higher than nearby people or things

ex.en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
ex.zh: 我们爬上塔，看着船只驶过海湾。

ex.en: The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.
ex.zh: 这座历史悠久的塔全年吸引着游客，为附近的商店和餐馆带来可观收入。

tip: 作动词常接over或above，表示远高于周围事物。

senses.en: A flat food patty, often served inside a round bread roll

ex.en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐点了一个豆类汉堡配沙拉。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以在供应传统肉类菜肴的同时提供植物基汉堡，以减少对环境的影响。

tip: burger也可指肉饼本身，并非都以牛肉制成。

senses.en: A thick woven covering for a floor.

ex.en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
ex.zh: 我们坐在地毯上打牌。

ex.en: Installing carpet in classrooms can reduce noise, although regular cleaning is necessary to maintain good hygiene.
ex.zh: 在教室里铺地毯可以降低噪声，但需要定期清洁以保持良好卫生。

tip: carpet常指大面积地毯；rug多指可移动的小块地毯。

senses.en: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images
a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。

ex.en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
ex.zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。

tip: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

senses.en: a breakfast food made from grains, often eaten with milk
a plant grown for grain, or the grain it produces

ex.en: She poured cold milk over her bowl of cereal.
ex.zh: 她把冷牛奶倒进盛着早餐麦片的碗里。

ex.en: Farmers may need to grow different cereal crops as changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural production.
ex.zh: 随着降雨模式变化影响农业生产，农民可能需要种植不同的谷类作物。

tip: 早餐食品泛指时常不可数；指谷物种类可用cereals。

senses.en: A cabinet with doors and shelves for storing things

ex.en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
ex.zh: 干净的碗放在水槽上方的橱柜里。

ex.en: Well-designed cupboards can maximise storage space in small apartments without making living areas feel crowded.
ex.zh: 设计合理的橱柜可以充分利用小公寓的储物空间，又不会让起居区域显得拥挤。

tip: cupboard中的p不发音；通常指带门的储物柜。

senses.en: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a subject.
A detailed examination of a subject in speech or writing.

ex.en: We had a lively discussion about our holiday plans.
ex.zh: 我们热烈讨论了度假计划。

ex.en: Public discussion of transport policy can help governments design services that better meet residents' needs.
ex.zh: 对交通政策的公开讨论可以帮助政府设计更符合居民需求的服务。

tip: 名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。

senses.en: Information explaining what to do or how to do something
An order telling someone what they must do
The activity of teaching someone a skill or subject

ex.en: The instructor gave one clear instruction: hold the rope tightly.
ex.zh: 教练给出了一条明确指示：紧紧抓住绳子。

ex.en: Students often benefit from practical instruction that connects classroom theory with everyday problems.
ex.zh: 将课堂理论与日常问题联系起来的实践教学往往能让学生受益。

tip: 操作说明常用复数instructions；表示教学时不可数。

senses.en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people.
A person or organization ahead of others in a field.

ex.en: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
ex.zh: 我们的领队给我们指明了最安全的山路。

ex.en: Effective leaders encourage employees to share ideas rather than simply follow instructions without question.
ex.zh: 高效的领导者鼓励员工分享想法，而不是毫无疑问地服从指令。

tip: leader指领导者；leadership指领导能力或领导层。

senses.en: To take something's place or put something else in its place.
To put something back where it was before.

ex.en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。

ex.en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
ex.zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。

tip: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。

senses.en: Coming after sixth and before eighth in an ordered sequence.
One of seven equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new flat is on the seventh floor.
ex.zh: 我们的新公寓在七楼。

ex.en: By the seventh week of the course, students were able to analyse basic scientific data independently.
ex.zh: 到课程第七周时，学生已能独立分析基本的科学数据。

tip: 序数词前通常用the；已有物主限定词时不用the。

senses.en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something
used to ask who something belongs to

ex.en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
ex.zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？

ex.en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
ex.zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。

tip: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

senses.en: To have a different opinion from someone else.
To give different information or results.

ex.en: We disagree about which colour to paint the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们对于厨房该刷什么颜色意见不一。

ex.en: Experts disagree on whether free public transport is the most effective way to reduce urban traffic.
ex.zh: 专家对于免费公共交通是否是减少城市交通流量的最有效方法意见不一。

tip: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

senses.en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

ex.en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。

ex.en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
ex.zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。

tip: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。

senses.en: having happened or started a short time ago

ex.en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
ex.zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。

tip: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

senses.en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid.
A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves.
Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.

ex.en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
ex.zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。

ex.en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。

tip: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

senses.en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills
a comfortable bus used for longer journeys
to train or teach someone to improve particular skills

ex.en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
ex.zh: 我们的教练示范了如何握球拍。

ex.en: A skilled coach can help young athletes build confidence while developing healthy attitudes towards competition.
ex.zh: 优秀的教练能帮助年轻运动员建立信心，同时培养他们对竞争的健康态度。

tip: 英式英语中coach也指长途客车，bus多指公交车。

senses.en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.

ex.en: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
ex.zh: 我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。

ex.en: Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.
ex.zh: 近百分之四十的受访居民支持将更多公共资金投入自行车基础设施。

tip: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。

senses.en: trousers with legs ending above or near the knees

ex.en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
ex.zh: 我为这次海滨度假打包了短裤和凉鞋。

ex.en: In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，轻薄的短裤能帮助人们在户外锻炼时保持舒适。

tip: shorts用复数；一条短裤说a pair of shorts。

senses.en: the land along the edge of the sea
to move without using power or much effort
to succeed or progress without trying very hard

ex.en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
ex.zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，捡了一些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Communities along the coast face increasing risks from rising sea levels and severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区面临着海平面上升和强风暴带来的日益严重的风险。

tip: on the coast指在海边；off the coast指在近海。

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

senses.en: Coming after the eighth and before the tenth.
One of nine equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new apartment is on the ninth floor.
ex.zh: 我们的新公寓在九楼。

ex.en: By the ninth year of the conservation programme, several endangered species had begun to recover.
ex.zh: 到保护项目实施的第九年，几种濒危物种的数量已开始回升。

tip: nine变ninth时去掉e；序数词前通常用the。

senses.en: an official document identifying you when travelling between countries
something that makes success or an opportunity possible

ex.en: I checked my bag twice to find my passport.
ex.zh: 我翻了两遍包才找到护照。

ex.en: A university degree is often viewed as a passport to better employment, although practical experience also matters.
ex.zh: 大学学位常被视为获得更好工作的通行证，不过实践经验也很重要。

tip: 比喻用法a passport to中，to后接名词。

senses.en: In the correct or suitable way.
Completely or to the degree that is needed.

ex.en: The kitchen door will not close properly in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天厨房的门总是关不严。

ex.en: Public recycling schemes are more effective when residents understand how to sort household waste properly.
ex.zh: 当居民了解如何正确分类生活垃圾时，公共回收计划会更有效。

tip: 修饰动作常用properly；修饰名词用proper。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

senses.en: Relating to Asia or its people.
A person from Asia or with family origins there.

ex.en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆展出了多个亚洲国家的陶器。

ex.en: Many Asian cities are expanding public transport networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 许多亚洲城市正扩建公共交通网络，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 首字母须大写；Asia是洲名，Asian可作形容词。

senses.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
To write a book, report, or other written work.

ex.en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
ex.zh: 这位作者回答了有关她新出版的冒险小说的问题。

ex.en: An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.
ex.zh: 作者可以借助陌生人物的经历呈现熟悉的问题，从而挑战社会观念。

tip: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

senses.en: Pain felt in the head.
A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.

ex.en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
ex.zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。

ex.en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
ex.zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。

tip: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

senses.en: A member of the police.
A member of the armed forces with authority to command.
Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.

ex.en: A police officer helped us find the station.
ex.zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。

ex.en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
ex.zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。

tip: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

senses.en: Food with a pastry base or covering and a filling.

ex.en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们分着吃了一个热苹果派。

ex.en: Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.
ex.zh: 水果派等传统菜肴有助于让地方饮食文化代代相传。

tip: pie指馅饼；“饼图”须说pie chart。

senses.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

ex.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

tip: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when something happens
a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash

ex.en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。

ex.en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。

tip: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

senses.en: Sheep's soft hair, or yarn and cloth made from it.

ex.en: This wool scarf keeps my neck warm on windy mornings.
ex.zh: 这条羊毛围巾让我的脖子在刮风的早晨保持温暖。

ex.en: Wool provides natural insulation, making it a useful material for clothing designed for cold climates.
ex.zh: 羊毛具有天然保温性能，因此适合用来制作寒冷气候下穿着的衣物。

tip: 通常不可数；一团毛线说a ball of wool。

senses.en: a building where Christians gather to worship
Christian religious worship attended as a service
an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices

ex.en: The old church has beautiful windows and a stone tower.
ex.zh: 这座古老的教堂有漂亮的窗户和一座石塔。

ex.en: Preserving a historic church can protect local heritage while providing opportunities for education and tourism.
ex.zh: 保护历史悠久的教堂既能保护当地文化遗产，也能为教育和旅游创造机会。

tip: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。

senses.en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest.
A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics.
To compete in speed or move very quickly.

ex.en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。

ex.en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
ex.zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。

tip: race可指竞速比赛或种族；不要与民族混同。

senses.en: A small round fruit with a stone and usually red skin
A tree grown for its cherries or attractive blossoms

ex.en: He placed a ripe cherry on top of the cake.
ex.zh: 他在蛋糕顶上放了一颗熟透的樱桃。

ex.en: Cherry trees attract visitors during spring, providing seasonal income for rural communities through tourism.
ex.zh: 樱花树在春季吸引游客，通过旅游业为乡村社区带来季节性收入。

tip: 复数为cherries；果核用stone（英）或pit（美）。

senses.en: Someone who plans how something will look or work.
Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.

ex.en: The designer showed us a model of our kitchen.
ex.zh: 设计师给我们看了我们厨房的模型。

ex.en: A skilled designer can make public spaces more accessible to people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的设计师能够让行动不便的人更方便地使用公共空间。

tip: 作形容词常置于衣物等名词前，强调设计师品牌。

senses.en: In a way that shows pleasure or enjoyment.
Willingly and without objection.
With a fortunate or pleasing result.

ex.en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
ex.zh: 孩子们一起做三明治，开心地聊着天。

ex.en: Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通服务更可靠、价格更实惠，许多居民都会乐意乘坐。

tip: 句首Happily可表“幸好”，不只表示开心。

senses.en: One of four equal parts of something.
A period of three months within a year.
An area of a town with a particular character.

ex.en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
ex.zh: 她把三明治切成四等份给孩子们吃。

ex.en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。

tip: a quarter of an hour是一刻钟；季度也是quarter。

senses.en: the top covering of a building or vehicle
to cover a building with a roof

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
ex.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。

ex.en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。

tip: 复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。

senses.en: A trained cook working in a restaurant or hotel.

ex.en: The chef added fresh herbs to the steaming soup.
ex.zh: 厨师往热气腾腾的汤里加入了新鲜香草。

ex.en: A skilled chef can design nutritious school meals that appeal to children while staying within a limited budget.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的厨师可以在有限预算内，设计出既营养又受孩子欢迎的学校餐食。

tip: chef 的 ch 发 /ʃ/；通常指餐馆或酒店的专业厨师。

senses.en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.

ex.en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。

ex.en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
ex.zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。

tip: 可数名词，复数为frogs；toad指蟾蜍。

senses.en: a round vegetable with layers and a strong smell

ex.en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
ex.zh: 切这个洋葱又让我流眼泪了。

ex.en: Growing onions and other vegetables locally can shorten supply chains and provide communities with fresher produce.
ex.zh: 在本地种植洋葱等蔬菜可以缩短供应链，为社区提供更新鲜的农产品。

tip: 开头是元音音素，单数前用an：an onion。

senses.en: A shiny greyish-white precious metal used for jewellery and coins.
Having a shiny greyish-white colour, or made of silver.
A medal awarded for second place in a competition.

ex.en: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
ex.zh: 这把小勺子是纯银做的。

ex.en: Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.
ex.zh: 银的导电性能极佳，因此被广泛用于电子设备。

tip: 表示金属银时不可数；a silver可指一枚银牌。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.

ex.en: It was stupid to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是太傻了。

ex.en: Calling students stupid can damage their confidence and discourage them from asking questions in class.
ex.zh: 说学生愚蠢会损害他们的信心，使他们不敢在课堂上提问。

tip: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

senses.en: a person paid to clean buildings or rooms
a substance or device used to remove dirt
having less dirt or causing less pollution

ex.en: The cleaner emptied the bins before the office opened.
ex.zh: 清洁工在办公室开门前清空了垃圾桶。

ex.en: Hospitals should provide every cleaner with suitable protective equipment and training to reduce infection risks.
ex.zh: 医院应为每位清洁工提供合适的防护装备和培训，以降低感染风险。

col: 窗户清洁工；玻璃清洁剂
tip: a cleaner通常指清洁工；cleaner也是clean的比较级。

senses.en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms

ex.en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
ex.zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。

ex.en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。

tip: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

senses.en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits

ex.en: She keeps digital copies of all her family photos.
ex.zh: 她保存着所有家庭照片的电子副本。

ex.en: Improving digital skills can help older adults access public services and maintain contact with distant relatives.
ex.zh: 提高数字技能可以帮助老年人使用公共服务，并与远方亲属保持联系。

tip: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。

senses.en: A Christian festival celebrating Jesus Christ's return to life.

ex.en: We decorated eggs together at the kitchen table for Easter.
ex.zh: 我们一起坐在厨房桌旁，为复活节装饰彩蛋。

ex.en: During Easter, many destinations attract additional visitors through seasonal events, creating temporary employment in the tourism sector.
ex.zh: 复活节期间，许多旅游目的地通过节庆活动吸引更多游客，为旅游业创造临时就业机会。

tip: 节日名首字母大写；at Easter指复活节期间。

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
ex.zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。

ex.en: Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.
ex.zh: 经济不确定时期，投资者会寻求他们认为相对安全的资产，黄金需求因此可能上升。

tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

senses.en: To move or act quickly, or make someone do so.
A need to act quickly because time is limited.

ex.en: We hurried home before the rain began to fall.
ex.zh: 我们赶在下雨前匆忙回家了。

ex.en: When teachers hurry through difficult material, students may struggle to develop a clear understanding of key concepts.
ex.zh: 教师匆忙讲解难点内容时，学生可能难以清楚理解核心概念。

tip: hurry up表示催促；in a hurry表示匆忙。

senses.en: A covered vehicle used to carry goods or people.

ex.en: We loaded the boxes into a small white van.
ex.zh: 我们把箱子装进了一辆白色的小型厢式货车。

ex.en: Replacing diesel delivery vans with electric vehicles could help reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 用电动车替换柴油送货车，有助于减少人口密集城市的空气污染。

tip: 常指载货的封闭式车辆；不要与敞篷货车混淆。

senses.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby
To go somewhere and bring someone or something away
To receive or gather money from people

ex.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
ex.zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。

ex.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
ex.zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。

tip: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。

senses.en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them.
An exciting or emotional event or situation.

ex.en: Our drama group rehearses in the hall every Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们的戏剧小组每周四在大厅排练。

ex.en: Teaching drama in schools can develop students' confidence and encourage them to consider different perspectives.
ex.zh: 在学校教授戏剧可以培养学生的自信，并鼓励他们从不同角度思考。

tip: 戏剧艺术用不可数drama；一部戏剧用a drama。

senses.en: A knitted piece of clothing covering the upper body.

senses.zh: 跳跃者；跳高或跳远运动员
senses.en: A person or animal that jumps, especially in sport.
A sleeveless dress worn over a shirt or blouse.

ex.en: I packed a warm jumper for the camping trip.
ex.zh: 我为这次露营带了一件暖和的套头毛衣。

ex.en: Wearing a jumper indoors can reduce the need for heating during colder months.
ex.zh: 在寒冷的月份，室内穿毛衣可以减少供暖需求。

tip: 英式英语指套头毛衣；美式通常用sweater。

senses.en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.

ex.en: Our professor brought ancient coins to class today.
ex.zh: 我们的教授今天带了古钱币来上课。

ex.en: The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.
ex.zh: 这位教授鼓励学生在对气候政策下结论之前评估不同的信息来源。

tip: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

senses.en: The activity of moving over snow on skis.

ex.en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，我们一起去滑雪了。

ex.en: Skiing attracts winter tourists to mountain regions, creating seasonal jobs but increasing demand for water.
ex.zh: 滑雪吸引冬季游客前往山区，创造了季节性工作，但也增加了用水需求。

tip: 滑雪用go skiing；滑水需说water skiing。

senses.en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft
to follow someone closely and watch where they go

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
ex.zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。

ex.en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
ex.zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

tip: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

senses.en: To become impossible to see or find.
To stop existing.

ex.en: We watched the boat disappear into the thick fog.
ex.zh: 我们看着小船消失在浓雾中。

ex.en: Many traditional crafts may disappear unless governments support skilled workers and encourage younger generations to learn them.
ex.zh: 除非政府支持技艺工人并鼓励年轻一代学习，否则许多传统手艺可能消失。

tip: 通常是不及物动词，不说 be disappeared。

senses.en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests

ex.en: We wore safety goggles while mixing liquids in the lab.
ex.zh: 我们在实验室混合液体时戴着护目镜。

ex.en: A well-equipped school lab allows students to test scientific ideas through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
ex.zh: 设备齐全的学校实验室让学生通过实际实验检验科学观点，而非仅仅死记硬背。

tip: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。

senses.en: to close something or stop being open for business
closed or not open for business

ex.en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
ex.zh: 请在雨飘进来之前把窗户关上。

ex.en: When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.
ex.zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民便失去了宝贵的免费学习资源和共享社区空间。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为shut；现在分词为shutting。

senses.en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.

ex.en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
ex.zh: 一位访客把她的伞落在了我们前门旁。

ex.en: The museum attracts international visitors by offering exhibitions that explore local history and culture.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆通过举办探究当地历史与文化的展览吸引国际游客。

tip: visitor指人；visit可作动词或名词。

senses.en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.

ex.en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。

ex.en: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
ex.zh: 面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。

tip: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

senses.en: Living rather than dead
Full of energy, activity, or excitement

ex.en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假回来后，那株小植物还活着。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地有助于让濒危物种存活，并维持整个地区的生态平衡。

tip: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

senses.en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.

ex.en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
ex.zh: 我们停下来欣赏湖泊的美景。

ex.en: Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护沿海地区的自然美景既能促进旅游业，也能保全珍贵的野生动物栖息地。

tip: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。

senses.en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed.
Someone or something that may cause harm.

ex.en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
ex.zh: 离边缘远一点，有掉下去的危险。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads pose a serious danger to cyclists, particularly in areas without dedicated cycling lanes.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路对骑车人构成严重威胁，尤其是在没有专用自行车道的地区。

tip: in danger指处于危险中；dangerous指会带来危险。

senses.en: Coming immediately after seventh in order
One of eight equal parts of something

ex.en: Our apartment is on the eighth floor of this building.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在这栋楼的八楼。

ex.en: The survey ranked public transport eighth among the factors influencing where young professionals choose to live.
ex.zh: 调查显示，在影响年轻专业人士居住地点选择的因素中，公共交通排在第八位。

tip: 序数词前通常用the；eighth末尾的th发/θ/。

senses.en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.

ex.en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
ex.zh: 打开之前，它看起来就是一个普通盒子。

ex.en: Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.
ex.zh: 城市规划应反映普通居民的需求，而不是只顾吸引富有的投资者。

tip: ordinary强调不特别；不等于表示平均水平的average。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft
done on a small scale to test whether something works
to fly an aircraft or test a new plan

ex.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
ex.zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。

ex.en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。

tip: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

senses.en: to take something without permission and keep or use it
to move quietly without attracting attention
something bought for much less than its usual price

ex.en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
ex.zh: 我买面包的时候，有人偷走了我的自行车。

ex.en: Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
ex.zh: 企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。

tip: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

senses.en: made of wood
showing little natural feeling or movement

ex.en: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺慢慢搅拌汤。

ex.en: Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.
ex.zh: 如果木材来自负责任管理的森林，木制建筑就能带来环境效益。

tip: wooden指木制；woody多指木质或像木头的。

senses.en: A comfortable chair with supports for your arms.
Giving opinions without direct experience or active involvement.

ex.en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair beside the window.
ex.zh: 爷爷在窗边的扶手椅上睡着了。

ex.en: Armchair critics may underestimate the practical challenges that teachers face when managing large classes with limited resources.
ex.zh: 缺乏实践经验的评论者可能低估教师在资源有限时管理大班所面临的实际困难。

tip: 坐在扶手椅里用in；作形容词时置于名词前，常含贬义。

senses.en: a machine that produces power to make something move
something that strongly drives growth or change
software that performs a particular core task within a system

ex.en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
ex.zh: 我们刚到车道入口，发动机就熄火了。

ex.en: Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.
ex.zh: 更清洁的发动机技术可以减少空气污染，但扩大公共交通仍是实现城市可持续出行的关键。

tip: engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is
the distance of something above the ground or sea
the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
ex.zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。

ex.en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

senses.en: The town or city where you grew up or come from.

ex.en: I return to my hometown every summer to visit relatives.
ex.zh: 我每年夏天都回家乡探望亲人。

ex.en: Many graduates leave their hometown to seek better employment opportunities in larger urban centres.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生离开家乡，前往更大的城市寻求更好的就业机会。

tip: 可指小镇或城市，不一定是出生地。

senses.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

ex.en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
ex.zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

tip: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions

ex.en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
ex.zh: 我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。

ex.en: A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
ex.zh: 扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。

tip: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。

senses.en: a liquid product used to wash hair
to wash hair using shampoo

ex.en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
ex.zh: 我为这次旅行装了一小瓶洗发水。

ex.en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
ex.zh: 使用可补充装的洗发水容器可以减少家庭和旅游业产生的塑料垃圾。

tip: 泛指洗发水通常不可数；一瓶用a bottle of shampoo。

senses.en: The system of connected pages accessed through the internet.
A structure of fine threads a spider makes to catch insects.
A complicated network of connected things or relationships.

ex.en: I found a simple soup recipe on the web.
ex.zh: 我在网上找到了一份简单的汤谱。

ex.en: Although the web provides convenient access to information, students must learn to evaluate the reliability of online sources.
ex.zh: 虽然万维网让获取信息更方便，但学生必须学会评估网络来源的可靠性。

tip: 上网常用on the web；web不完全等同于internet。

senses.en: Having a lot of wind.

ex.en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
ex.zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。

ex.en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。

tip: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

senses.en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used.
To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.

ex.en: A sudden storm destroyed the old shed behind our house.
ex.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨摧毁了我们屋后的旧棚子。

ex.en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
ex.zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。

tip: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

senses.en: a door or passage used to leave a place
to leave a place or close a computer program

ex.en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
ex.zh: 我们在电影院后部找到了出口。

ex.en: Public buildings must have clearly visible emergency exits so that occupants can leave safely during an evacuation.
ex.zh: 公共建筑必须设有清晰可见的紧急出口，以便楼内人员在疏散时安全离开。

tip: 名词指“出口”，动词指“离开”；不要与 exist 混淆。

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.en: A plant whose strong-smelling bulbs are used to flavour food.

ex.en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the soup.
ex.zh: 先把大蒜压碎，再放进汤里。

ex.en: Using garlic and herbs can add flavour to meals without increasing their salt content.
ex.zh: 使用大蒜和香草可以给饭菜增添风味，而不增加盐含量。

tip: 通常不可数；一瓣大蒜用a clove of garlic。

senses.en: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer

senses.zh: 乐器键盘；电子键盘乐器
senses.en: A musical instrument's keys, or an electronic instrument with keys

ex.en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
ex.zh: 开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。

ex.en: Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.
ex.zh: 行动不便的学生可能受益于经过改装的键盘，从而更方便地参与数字化学习。

tip: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。

senses.en: Most recent or newest.
The most recent news, developments, or products.

ex.en: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
ex.zh: 你听说关于我们邻居的最新消息了吗？

ex.en: The latest research suggests that regular physical activity can improve both memory and mental health.
ex.zh: 最新研究表明，规律运动可以改善记忆力和心理健康。

tip: latest指最新；last常指上一个或最后一个。

senses.en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another

ex.en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
ex.zh: 我们不在家时，邻居帮忙给植物浇了水。

ex.en: Shared gardens can strengthen relationships between neighbours and create a greater sense of belonging in urban communities.
ex.zh: 共享花园可以增进邻里关系，增强城市社区居民的归属感。

tip: 英式拼写neighbour，美式拼写neighbor。

senses.en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.

ex.en: We had vegetable soup at the village pub.
ex.zh: 我们在村里的酒馆喝了蔬菜汤。

ex.en: In some rural communities, the local pub provides an important meeting place for residents.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，当地酒馆为居民提供了重要的聚会场所。

tip: pub多见于英国语境，常供应餐食，不等于旅馆。

senses.en: To be owned by someone
To have a proper place or category
To feel accepted as part of a group

ex.en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
ex.zh: 这把蓝色雨伞是我妹妹的。

ex.en: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
ex.zh: 社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。

tip: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

senses.en: Containing so many people or things that little space remains

ex.en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
ex.zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。

ex.en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
ex.zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。

tip: be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

senses.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

ex.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我祖父每周日都和朋友打高尔夫球。

ex.en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
ex.zh: 高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。

col: 高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部
tip: 球类运动前通常不加冠词：play golf。

senses.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

ex.en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
ex.zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。

ex.en: Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
ex.zh: 能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。

tip: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

senses.en: Unhappy because you lack companionship or close connections.
Far from people or rarely visited.

ex.en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
ex.zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。

ex.en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。

tip: alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。

senses.en: a piece of jewellery worn around the neck

ex.en: She wore a silver necklace with a tiny bird.
ex.zh: 她戴着一条带有小鸟吊坠的银项链。

ex.en: A handmade necklace can reflect local traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
ex.zh: 一条手工项链既能体现当地传统，也能为农村社区的手工艺人带来收入。

tip: 结尾-lace读/ləs/，不是单词lace的读音。

senses.en: A British coin or unit worth one hundredth of a pound.
An American coin worth one hundredth of a dollar.

ex.en: I found a penny underneath the sofa this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在沙发底下发现了一枚便士硬币。

ex.en: For families on low incomes, every penny saved on energy bills can make a difference.
ex.zh: 对于低收入家庭，能源账单上省下的每一分钱都可能有所帮助。

tip: 英国金额复数用pence；指多枚硬币用pennies。

senses.en: corn kernels heated until they burst into light, fluffy pieces

ex.en: We shared a bowl of popcorn during the film.
ex.zh: 看电影时，我们一起吃了一碗爆米花。

ex.en: Cinemas often earn additional revenue by selling snacks such as popcorn alongside tickets for film screenings.
ex.zh: 电影院除了出售电影票，往往还通过销售爆米花等零食获得额外收入。

tip: 通常是不可数名词；一颗可说a piece of popcorn。

senses.en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines
A device that displays written material or reads stored information
A book designed to help learners develop reading skills

ex.en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
ex.zh: 莉娜热爱阅读，总是随身带着一本书。

ex.en: Digital libraries allow readers in remote communities to access educational resources without travelling to larger towns.
ex.zh: 数字图书馆让偏远社区的读者无需前往较大的城镇，就能获取教育资源。

tip: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

senses.en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles
an open public area surrounded by buildings
shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units

ex.en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。

ex.en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。

tip: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

senses.en: A person who helps someone with their work.
Having a supporting role below the main person in charge.

ex.en: The assistant brought fresh towels into the treatment room.
ex.zh: 助手把干净的毛巾拿进了治疗室。

ex.en: Teaching assistants can provide additional support for children who need more individual attention in large classes.
ex.zh: 在大班教学中，助教可以为需要更多个别关注的孩子提供额外支持。

tip: assistant指人，assistance指帮助，通常不可数。

senses.en: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire.
Equipment for cooking food over a fire outdoors.
To cook food on a grill over a fire.

ex.en: We invited our neighbours to a barbecue in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们邀请邻居来花园参加烧烤聚餐。

ex.en: Designated barbecue areas allow visitors to cook outdoors while reducing the risk of fires in public parks.
ex.zh: 指定烧烤区既能让游客在户外烹饪，也能降低公园发生火灾的风险。

tip: 既指烧烤聚餐或烤架，也可作动词；常缩写为BBQ。

senses.en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another.
Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.

ex.en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
ex.zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。

ex.en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
ex.zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。

tip: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

senses.en: Meat from a pig, used as food.

ex.en: We cooked the pork slowly with apples and onions.
ex.zh: 我们把猪肉和苹果、洋葱一起慢炖。

ex.en: Clear food labelling helps consumers identify products containing pork and make choices that suit their dietary requirements.
ex.zh: 清晰的食品标签有助于消费者识别含猪肉的产品，并作出符合自身饮食要求的选择。

tip: pork是不可数名词，指肉；活猪用pig。

senses.en: to say that you will not do or accept something
unwanted waste material that people throw away

ex.en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
ex.zh: 不带上她最喜欢的蓝色雨伞，她就不肯走。

ex.en: Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能拒绝批准威胁野生动物栖息地或增加洪灾风险的开发项目。

tip: 名词读/ˈrefjuːs/；动词后接to do，不接doing。

senses.en: Tiny loose grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts.
To make a surface smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper.

ex.en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
ex.zh: 孩子们用湿沙堆了一座城堡。

ex.en: Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.
ex.zh: 为建筑工程开采河床中的沙子可能破坏栖息地，并增加侵蚀风险。

tip: 表示沙子时不可数；一粒沙用a grain of sand。

senses.en: a sweet fizzy drink, especially in American English
water containing dissolved gas, often mixed with other drinks

ex.en: I spilled orange soda all over the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 我把橙味汽水洒得厨房地板上到处都是。

ex.en: Replacing sugary soda with water can help reduce daily sugar intake and support better dental health.
ex.zh: 用水代替含糖汽水有助于减少每日糖摄入，并改善牙齿健康。

tip: 美式常指汽水；baking soda才是小苏打。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

ex.en: The storm cut off electricity to our entire street.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致我们整条街停电了。

ex.en: Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
ex.zh: 利用可再生能源发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低温室气体排放。

tip: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。

senses.en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs.
An animal or person of the female sex.

ex.en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
ex.zh: 母狮和幼狮一起在阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 鼓励女生学习工程学有助于减少科技行业中的性别不平等。

tip: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。

senses.en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm.
A male person or animal.

ex.en: The male duck has a shiny green head.
ex.zh: 这只公鸭有一个亮闪闪的绿色脑袋。

ex.en: Encouraging more male applicants to enter nursing could help address staff shortages and challenge gender stereotypes.
ex.zh: 鼓励更多男性申请进入护理行业，有助于缓解人员短缺并打破性别刻板印象。

col: 男性和女性；雄性和雌性
tip: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。

senses.en: A large round fruit with thick skin and sweet, juicy flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a ripe melon for our picnic.
ex.zh: 她切了一个熟甜瓜，供我们野餐时吃。

ex.en: Farmers growing melons in dry regions often use efficient irrigation systems to reduce water consumption.
ex.zh: 干旱地区种植甜瓜的农民常使用高效灌溉系统来减少用水量。

tip: melon泛指甜瓜类；watermelon专指西瓜。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们明天中午在图书馆外见吧。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.
ex.zh: 户外工作者应避免在正午前后进行高强度体力活动，此时气温可能很高，阳光也可能特别强烈。

tip: 说at noon，不说in noon；正午是12 p.m.。

senses.en: having a pleasant flavour

ex.en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
ex.zh: 这道美味的汤很适合寒冷的夜晚。

ex.en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用新鲜蔬菜和全谷物制作的美味餐食，鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: tasty指食物美味；tasteful指有品位。

senses.en: To receive money in return for work.
To gain something deserved through your actions or qualities.

ex.en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后帮人遛狗，赚些零花钱。

ex.en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
ex.zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。

tip: earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。

senses.en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly

ex.en: Her new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
ex.zh: 她的新工作薪水更高，工时也更短。

ex.en: Although salary influences career choices, many graduates also value job security and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 虽然薪水会影响职业选择，但许多毕业生也重视工作保障和职业发展机会。

tip: salary指固定薪金；wages常指按时或按周计算的工资。

senses.en: not true or based on facts
made to resemble something real or natural
intended to hide someone's real feelings or intentions

ex.en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
ex.zh: 那条关于我们邻居的传闻完全不实。

ex.en: Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.
ex.zh: 声称所有网络信息都可靠是错误的，因此学生应学会批判性地评估信息来源。

tip: false指不真实；fake更强调刻意仿冒。通常写作小写。

senses.en: A small container or wrapped quantity of something.
A small unit of data transmitted across a network.

ex.en: She opened a packet of biscuits for the journey.
ex.zh: 她打开了一包饼干，准备在路上吃。

ex.en: Charging customers for each packet of disposable utensils could encourage more sustainable habits in the food industry.
ex.zh: 对每包一次性餐具收费，可以推动餐饮行业形成更可持续的习惯。

tip: 英式常用a packet of；美式常依物品用pack或bag。

senses.en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas.
A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.

ex.en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
ex.zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。

ex.en: Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 在户外放飞气球可能危害野生动物，因为橡胶碎片会落入河流和海洋。

tip: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes
a long area with a particular feature
a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects

ex.en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
ex.zh: 这条腰带能防止我的裤子往下滑。

ex.en: A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.
ex.zh: 城市周边的绿化带可以限制城市扩张，保护附近农田免遭开发。

tip: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。

senses.en: Relating to Europe or its people.
A person from Europe.

ex.en: We explored several European cities during our summer holiday.
ex.zh: 暑假期间，我们游览了几座欧洲城市。

ex.en: Many European countries have invested in railway networks to reduce dependence on short domestic flights.
ex.zh: 许多欧洲国家投资建设铁路网，以减少对短途国内航班的依赖。

tip: 首字母大写；前用a而非an，不等同于欧盟的。

senses.en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

ex.en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
ex.zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

tip: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

senses.en: a vegetable with leaves often eaten raw in salads

ex.en: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
ex.zh: 把生菜洗净后再夹进三明治里。

ex.en: Growing lettuce in urban gardens can give residents access to fresh food near their homes.
ex.zh: 在城市菜园种植生菜能让居民在家附近获得新鲜食材。

tip: 指食材通常不可数；一棵生菜用a head of lettuce。

senses.en: having little distance from one side to the other
limited in range or achieved by only a small margin
to become or make something less wide or extensive

ex.en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
ex.zh: 这条狭窄的小路只容得下我们排成一列走。

ex.en: Governments should invest in rural schools to narrow the educational gap between urban and remote communities.
ex.zh: 政府应投资乡村学校，缩小城市与偏远社区之间的教育差距。

tip: narrow down表示缩小选择范围，不指道路变窄。

senses.en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.

ex.en: This paragraph is too long for a quick email.
ex.zh: 对于一封简短的邮件来说，这一段太长了。

ex.en: Each paragraph in an academic essay should develop a clear argument supported by relevant evidence.
ex.zh: 学术文章的每一段都应展开一个清晰的论点，并以相关证据加以支持。

tip: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。

senses.en: Used when something is possible but not certain.
Used to make a suggestion or request sound less direct.

ex.en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.
ex.zh: 政府或许可以让低收入家庭更买得起新鲜农产品，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。

senses.en: with little or no noise
without attracting attention or making something widely known

ex.en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门，宝宝正在睡觉。

ex.en: Students who work quietly in shared study areas help create an environment that supports concentration.
ex.zh: 在公共学习区域安静学习的学生有助于营造利于专注的环境。

tip: quietly是副词；注意别与quite（相当）混淆。

senses.en: someone who grows and cares for plants in a garden

ex.en: The gardener planted bright flowers along our front path.
ex.zh: 园丁沿着我们门前的小路种下了鲜艳的花。

ex.en: Community gardeners can improve urban biodiversity by growing native plants that provide food and shelter for wildlife.
ex.zh: 社区园艺爱好者可以种植为野生动物提供食物和栖息处的本土植物，从而改善城市生物多样性。

tip: 既可指职业园丁，也可指在自家种花种菜的爱好者。

senses.en: The system or process that keeps a building warm.
The process of making something warmer.

ex.en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
ex.zh: 傍晚天凉起来时，我们打开了暖气。

ex.en: Improving home insulation can reduce heating costs and lower the environmental impact of household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 改善住宅保温可以降低供暖费用，并减轻家庭能源消耗对环境的影响。

tip: 指供暖时通常不可数：turn on the heating。

senses.en: animal skin treated for making clothes, bags, and other goods

ex.en: Her old leather bag still feels soft and smooth.
ex.zh: 她的旧皮包摸起来仍然柔软光滑。

ex.en: Some consumers avoid leather products because they are concerned about animal welfare and the environmental impact of production.
ex.zh: 一些消费者避免购买皮革制品，因为他们关心动物福利以及生产对环境的影响。

tip: 通常不可数；leather jacket中名词作定语。

senses.en: bags and cases that hold your belongings when travelling

ex.en: Our luggage barely fitted into the small taxi.
ex.zh: 我们的行李勉强塞进了那辆小出租车。

ex.en: Providing secure luggage storage at railway stations can encourage tourists to explore nearby attractions on foot.
ex.zh: 在火车站提供安全的行李寄存服务，可以鼓励游客步行游览附近景点。

tip: 不可数；一件行李用a piece of luggage。

senses.en: able to move or be moved easily between places
relating to phones or services used while away from home
a telephone you can carry and use almost anywhere

ex.en: The mobile library visits our village every Friday morning.
ex.zh: 流动图书馆每周五早晨来我们村。

ex.en: Mobile clinics can improve access to basic healthcare for people living in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 流动诊所可以让偏远农村社区的居民更容易获得基本医疗服务。

tip: 英式英语常用a mobile指手机；美式常说a cell phone。

senses.en: someone who plays music, especially professionally

ex.en: A musician played the violin outside the station.
ex.zh: 一位乐手在车站外拉小提琴。

ex.en: Local musicians can strengthen community identity by performing traditional songs at public festivals and cultural events.
ex.zh: 当地音乐人可以在公共节庆和文化活动中演奏传统歌曲，增强社区认同感。

tip: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。

senses.en: Closest in distance, time, or similarity
At the shortest distance from someone or something

ex.en: Could you show me the way to the nearest pharmacy?
ex.zh: 你能告诉我去最近的药店怎么走吗？

ex.en: For many rural residents, the nearest hospital is several hours away, making access to emergency care difficult.
ex.zh: 对许多农村居民而言，最近的医院也有数小时路程，这让急诊医疗服务难以获得。

tip: near的最高级；作定语时通常用the nearest。

senses.en: An international sporting competition with summer and winter editions.

ex.en: Our family watched the Olympics together after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们全家晚饭后一起观看了奥运会。

ex.en: Hosting the Olympics can improve transport infrastructure, but governments must consider the long-term costs of maintaining sports facilities.
ex.zh: 举办奥运会可以改善交通基础设施，但政府必须考虑维护体育设施的长期成本。

tip: 首字母大写，通常与the连用；也称the Olympic Games。

senses.en: programs that tell a computer how to perform tasks

ex.en: This software helps me edit photos on my laptop.
ex.zh: 这个软件帮助我在笔记本电脑上编辑照片。

ex.en: Schools need reliable software and adequate teacher training to make effective use of digital learning tools.
ex.zh: 学校需要可靠的软件和充分的教师培训，才能有效利用数字学习工具。

tip: 不可数：说some software，不说a software。

senses.en: light and warmth coming from the sun

senses.zh: 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
senses.en: happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness

ex.en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。

ex.en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。

tip: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

ex.en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
ex.zh: 我们看着马戏演员抛接色彩鲜艳的球。

ex.en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
ex.zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。

tip: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。

ex.en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
ex.zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。

tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: The feeling of being pleased or satisfied with life.

ex.en: Her face shone with happiness when the puppy arrived.
ex.zh: 小狗到来时，她的脸上洋溢着喜悦。

ex.en: Strong social connections often contribute more to lasting happiness than the purchase of expensive possessions.
ex.zh: 与购买昂贵物品相比，牢固的社会联系往往更能带来持久的幸福。

tip: 通常不可数：表达幸福用happiness，不加a。

senses.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.
A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing.
Having a pleasant sound resembling music.

ex.en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
ex.zh: 他把乐器放在沙发旁边。

ex.en: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
ex.zh: 提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。

tip: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。

senses.en: a small creature with eight legs, often making webs

ex.en: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
ex.zh: 一只小蜘蛛在我们窗边结了网。

ex.en: Although many people fear spiders, these creatures help control insect populations in gardens and agricultural environments.
ex.zh: 虽然许多人害怕蜘蛛，但它们有助于控制花园和农业环境中的昆虫数量。

tip: 蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于六条腿的昆虫。

senses.en: A company that transports passengers or goods by aircraft

ex.en: The airline sent us new tickets after cancelling our flight.
ex.zh: 航班取消后，航空公司给我们发了新机票。

ex.en: Airlines can lower their environmental impact by investing in more efficient aircraft and reducing unnecessary flights.
ex.zh: 航空公司可以通过投资更高效的飞机并减少不必要的航班来降低环境影响。

tip: airline指航空公司；具体航班用flight。

senses.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation
to mark something as needing attention
to become weaker or less energetic

ex.en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
ex.zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在校门上方飘扬。

ex.en: Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.
ex.zh: 教师应尽早指出潜在的学习困难，以便学生获得适当的支持。

tip: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
ex.zh: 她的孙子每周日都来看她，并帮忙做饭。

ex.en: Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.
ex.zh: 经常与孙辈联系能帮助老年人增强与社会的联系感。

tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

senses.en: a unit of distance equal to one thousand meters

ex.en: The nearest bakery is about a kilometer from here.
ex.zh: 最近的面包店离这里大约一公里。

ex.en: Providing reliable public transport within a kilometer of residential areas could reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 在居民区一公里范围内提供可靠的公共交通，可以减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为kilometre，符号km不加s。

senses.en: An urban railway system that often runs underground.

ex.en: We took the metro to the museum this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午，我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

ex.en: Expanding the metro could reduce traffic congestion by providing residents with a reliable alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 扩建地铁能为居民提供可靠的私家车替代出行方式，从而缓解交通拥堵。

tip: metro不限于法国；乘地铁常说take the metro。

senses.en: glasses with dark lenses that protect eyes from bright sunlight

ex.en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。

ex.en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。

tip: 通常用复数；一副说a pair of sunglasses。

senses.en: travel for pleasure and the businesses serving people who travel

ex.en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天，旅游业都会为我们村带来许多游客。

ex.en: Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.
ex.zh: 可持续旅游能为当地社区创造收入，同时保护吸引游客的自然景观。

tip: tourism通常不可数；表示一个游客用a tourist。

senses.en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings.
A book used to record appointments and future plans.

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前会写日记。

ex.en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
ex.zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。

tip: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

senses.en: Someone who manages an organisation, department, or company.
Someone who guides actors and controls a film or play.

ex.en: Our director welcomed the new staff at breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们的主管在早餐时欢迎了新员工。

ex.en: A museum director must balance the need to attract visitors with the responsibility to preserve valuable collections.
ex.zh: 博物馆馆长必须在吸引参观者的需求与保护珍贵藏品的责任之间取得平衡。

tip: 既可指机构主管或董事，也可指影视、戏剧导演。

senses.en: A machine carrying people or goods between floors.

ex.en: We took the elevator because our bags were heavy.
ex.zh: 我们的包很重，所以我们乘了电梯。

ex.en: Installing elevators in older apartment buildings can significantly improve accessibility for elderly residents and people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 在老旧公寓楼中安装电梯可以显著方便老年居民和残障人士出入。

tip: 电梯在美式英语中常用elevator，英式常用lift。

senses.en: a sticky substance used to join things together
to join things together using glue

ex.en: Use a little glue to fix the paper wing.
ex.zh: 用一点胶水把纸翅膀粘好。

ex.en: Some packaging contains layers joined with glue, which can make the materials more difficult to recycle.
ex.zh: 有些包装的各层材料用胶粘合，这可能增加回收难度。

tip: 作名词通常不可数；be glued to可指目不转睛地看。

senses.en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.

ex.en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
ex.zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。

ex.en: Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.
ex.zh: 为每个账户设置不同的密码，可以降低个人信息被盗的风险。

tip: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

senses.en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin

ex.en: We grilled sausages and served them with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们烤了香肠，配上新鲜蔬菜端上桌。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly choosing vegetarian sausages as they seek alternatives to traditional meat products.
ex.zh: 随着消费者寻找传统肉制品的替代品，越来越多人开始选择素香肠。

tip: 单根香肠可数；sausage meat指香肠肉馅，不可数。

senses.en: A fish with a cartilage skeleton and usually sharp teeth.
Someone who cheats others, especially to get their money.

ex.en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条鲨鱼在水族馆的玻璃后缓缓游动。

ex.en: Protecting shark populations helps maintain balanced marine ecosystems because many species regulate the numbers of other animals.
ex.zh: 保护鲨鱼种群有助于维持海洋生态平衡，因为许多鲨鱼物种能调节其他动物的数量。

tip: loan shark指放高利贷者，不是某种鲨鱼。

senses.en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable
To a serious or harmful degree
Very much, especially when wanting or needing something

ex.en: I slept badly because the room was too hot.
ex.zh: 房间太热，我睡得很不好。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads can badly affect rural communities by limiting access to schools, hospitals, and markets.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路会限制人们前往学校、医院和市场，严重影响农村社区。

tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；不是bad的形容词用法。

senses.en: the science of substances and how they react
the chemical properties and processes of a substance
a natural connection or attraction between people

ex.en: We mixed two clear liquids in chemistry class today.
ex.zh: 今天化学课上，我们把两种透明液体混合在一起。

ex.en: Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.
ex.zh: 了解海水的化学特性有助于科学家解释碳排放增加如何影响海洋生物。

tip: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

senses.en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric.
Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.

ex.en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
ex.zh: 这件棉衬衫洗了很多次后摸起来仍然很柔软。

ex.en: Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.
ex.zh: 棉花生产会给供水带来相当大的压力，尤其是在降雨量有限的地区。

tip: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。

senses.en: forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair

ex.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
ex.zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。

ex.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
ex.zh: 广告应展现外貌各异的人，包括卷发者和不同肤色的人。

tip: curly卷曲程度明显；wavy通常指轻柔的波浪状。

senses.en: waste material that people throw away
something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality

ex.en: Please take the garbage out before it starts smelling.
ex.zh: 请在垃圾发臭之前把它拿出去。

ex.en: Cities can reduce the amount of garbage sent to landfill by improving recycling facilities and public awareness.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善回收设施和提高公众意识，减少运往填埋场的垃圾量。

tip: 不可数名词；常见于美式英语，英式多用rubbish。

senses.en: relating to India or its people
a person from India

ex.en: We cooked an Indian curry for dinner last night.
ex.zh: 我们昨晚做了一道印度咖喱当晚餐。

ex.en: Indian cities face growing pressure to expand public transport as urban populations continue to increase.
ex.zh: 随着城市人口持续增加，印度城市面临着扩大公共交通的日益增长的压力。

tip: 首字母大写；指美洲原住民时宜用其自称。

senses.en: A thick, usually tomato-based sauce served with food.

ex.en: He squeezed some ketchup onto his plate of chips.
ex.zh: 他往那盘薯条上挤了些番茄酱。

ex.en: Reducing added sugar in everyday products such as ketchup could help consumers make healthier dietary choices.
ex.zh: 减少番茄酱等日常食品中的添加糖，有助于消费者作出更健康的饮食选择。

tip: 不可数；与浓缩烹饪用的tomato paste不同。

senses.en: Behaving badly, especially by disobeying adults

ex.en: The naughty puppy dragged my slippers into the garden.
ex.zh: 那只淘气的小狗把我的拖鞋拖进了花园。

ex.en: Children described as naughty may benefit more from patient guidance than from repeated punishment.
ex.zh: 被说成淘气的孩子可能更需要耐心引导，而非反复惩罚。

tip: 常用于小孩或宠物，通常不表示严重的恶行。

senses.en: making a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds

ex.en: Our noisy washing machine woke everyone up this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，吵闹的洗衣机把大家都吵醒了。

ex.en: Living near noisy roads can affect sleep quality and increase stress among urban residents.
ex.zh: 住在嘈杂的道路附近可能影响城市居民的睡眠质量并加重压力。

tip: noisy是形容词，noise是名词；注意不是nosy。

senses.en: A flat, round cake made by frying a liquid mixture

ex.en: He flipped the pancake and reached for the honey.
ex.zh: 他把煎饼翻了个面，伸手去拿蜂蜜。

ex.en: Preparing pancakes in cooking classes allows students to practise measuring ingredients and using kitchen equipment safely.
ex.zh: 在烹饪课上制作煎饼，让学生有机会练习称量食材和安全使用厨房设备。

tip: 英式通常较薄，美式通常较厚且蓬松。

senses.en: A small, round, green seed eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。

ex.en: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
ex.zh: 在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用的豌豆通常用复数peas。

senses.en: Enjoyable or comfortable to experience.
Friendly and polite towards other people.

ex.en: We enjoyed a pleasant walk beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边愉快地散了步。

ex.en: Public gardens provide pleasant spaces where residents can exercise, socialise, and escape the pressures of urban life.
ex.zh: 公共花园提供舒适宜人的空间，让居民锻炼、社交，并暂时摆脱城市生活的压力。

tip: pleasant形容事物令人愉快；pleased形容人感到高兴。

senses.en: A large printed picture or announcement displayed on a surface

ex.en: She hung a colourful poster above her desk.
ex.zh: 她在书桌上方挂了一张色彩鲜艳的海报。

ex.en: A well-designed poster can encourage people to recycle by presenting environmental messages clearly and attractively.
ex.zh: 设计精良的海报可以清晰而有吸引力地传达环保信息，鼓励人们回收利用。

tip: poster 是海报；postcard 是明信片，注意区分。

senses.en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.

ex.en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 公主从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
ex.zh: 传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。

tip: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

senses.en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images
a person or business that prints books and other materials

ex.en: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
ex.zh: 我的作业打印到一半时，打印机没纸了。

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.
ex.zh: 学校可以将所有打印机设为自动双面打印，从而减少纸张浪费。

tip: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

ex.en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。

ex.en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。

tip: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

senses.en: relating to Sweden, its people, or its language
the main language spoken in Sweden

ex.en: Our Swedish neighbour taught us to bake cinnamon buns.
ex.zh: 我们的瑞典邻居教我们烤肉桂卷。

ex.en: Swedish cities offer useful examples of how urban planning can support cycling and reduce dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 瑞典城市提供了有益的实例，展示城市规划如何支持骑行并减少对汽车的依赖。

tip: 首字母大写；一位瑞典人用a Swede。

senses.en: surrounded by people or things
within or shared by a group

ex.en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
ex.zh: 我们在树林中发现了一座小木屋。

ex.en: Regular exercise is increasingly popular among office workers who spend most of their day sitting.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼在一天大部分时间坐着的上班族中越来越受欢迎。

tip: among强调群体内部；between也可用于多者的明确关系。

senses.en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while walking down the steps.
ex.zh: 她下台阶时扭伤了脚踝。

ex.en: Appropriate footwear can reduce the risk of ankle injuries during physical exercise and outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 合适的鞋子可以降低体育锻炼和户外活动中脚踝受伤的风险。

tip: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

senses.en: Someone who cuts men's hair and trims or shaves beards.

ex.en: The barber trimmed my hair before the wedding.
ex.zh: 婚礼前，理发师给我修剪了头发。

ex.en: Local businesses, such as a neighbourhood barber, provide essential services and create opportunities for informal social interaction.
ex.zh: 社区理发师等本地商家提供基本服务，也为非正式社交创造机会。

tip: barber主要为男士理发修面；barber's可指理发店。

senses.en: A large container that you sit in to wash your body.

ex.en: The kitten watched water dripping into the empty bathtub.
ex.zh: 小猫看着水滴进空浴缸。

ex.en: Replacing a bathtub with a shower can save space in small urban apartments.
ex.zh: 在小型城市公寓中，用淋浴设施替换浴缸可以节省空间。

tip: bathtub尤常用于美式英语；英式常说bath。

senses.en: a shelf used for storing books

ex.en: She placed her favourite novel on the wooden bookshelf.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放到了木书架上。

ex.en: A well-stocked bookshelf in every classroom can encourage children to explore subjects beyond the school curriculum.
ex.zh: 每间教室都配备藏书丰富的书架，可以鼓励孩子探索学校课程以外的主题。

tip: 复数为bookshelves，注意把f变为ves。

senses.en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old castle.
ex.zh: 我们爬上山丘，去探索那座古堡。

ex.en: Restoring a historic castle can attract tourists while preserving valuable evidence of a region's architectural heritage.
ex.zh: 修复历史城堡既能吸引游客，也能保留体现当地建筑遗产的珍贵实物。

tip: castle中的t不发音；palace指宫殿。

senses.en: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.

ex.en: I added a comma to make the sentence clearer.
ex.zh: 我加了一个逗号，让句子更清楚。

ex.en: A misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence and confuse readers of academic writing.
ex.zh: 位置不当的逗号可能改变句意，使学术文章的读者产生困惑。

tip: comma是逗号，句号通常叫full stop（英）或period（美）。

senses.en: A designated place where people or vehicles cross.
A journey across water or another geographical barrier.

ex.en: We waited at the crossing until the cars stopped.
ex.zh: 我们在人行横道前等到车辆停下才过马路。

ex.en: Installing a pedestrian crossing near every school can help protect children and encourage more families to walk.
ex.zh: 在每所学校附近设置人行横道，有助于保护儿童并鼓励更多家庭步行。

tip: 作名词可指过街地点，也可指乘船横渡的行程。

senses.en: the activity of catching fish for pleasure or food

ex.en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早饭前，我们去湖边钓鱼了。

ex.en: Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 严格限制商业捕鱼能帮助海洋生态系统恢复，并长期支持沿海社区的生计。

tip: 说“去钓鱼”用go fishing，不用go to fishing。

senses.en: Work done to keep a home clean and tidy.

ex.en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
ex.zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。

ex.en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
ex.zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。

tip: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

senses.en: A small animal with six legs and three main body sections.

ex.en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的小昆虫落在了我的袖子上。

ex.en: Many insect species pollinate crops, making their protection essential for food production and healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 许多昆虫物种为农作物授粉，因此保护它们对粮食生产和健康的生态系统至关重要。

tip: 可数名词；蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于昆虫。

senses.en: The activity or habit of breathing in smoke from tobacco.

ex.en: My uncle gave up smoking and now enjoys long walks.
ex.zh: 我叔叔戒了烟，现在很喜欢长距离散步。

ex.en: Banning smoking in public buildings can protect workers and visitors from the harmful effects of tobacco smoke.
ex.zh: 禁止在公共建筑内吸烟可以保护工作人员和访客免受烟草烟雾的危害。

tip: 表示吸烟活动时不可数；戒烟可用give up smoking。

senses.en: Unpleasant to look at.
Unpleasant or threatening, especially involving anger or conflict.

ex.en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
ex.zh: 我们用木制屏风遮住了那些难看的管道。

ex.en: Poorly planned developments can create ugly urban landscapes that reduce residents' satisfaction with their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 规划不善的开发项目可能形成难看的城市景观，降低居民对社区的满意度。

tip: 比较级uglier，最高级ugliest；形容人外貌不礼貌。

senses.en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.

ex.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
ex.zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。

ex.en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。

tip: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。

senses.zh: 无线网络；无线联网技术
senses.en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.

ex.en: The café offers free wifi near the window seats.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆靠窗的座位附近有免费无线网络。

ex.en: Providing reliable public wifi can help residents access essential services and participate in online learning.
ex.zh: 提供可靠的公共无线网络，有助于居民使用基本服务并参与在线学习。

tip: 常规范写作Wi-Fi；通常不可数，不加a。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
ex.zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。

ex.en: Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
ex.zh: 数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。

tip: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

senses.en: the scientific study of living things
the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing

ex.en: We examined onion cells under microscopes in biology today.
ex.zh: 今天的生物课上，我们用显微镜观察了洋葱细胞。

ex.en: A basic understanding of biology helps people evaluate health information and make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 掌握基础生物学知识有助于人们评估健康信息，并对生活方式作出明智决定。

tip: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

senses.en: Having pale yellow hair, or describing this hair colour.
A woman or girl with pale yellow hair.

ex.en: Her blonde hair shone brightly in the afternoon sun.
ex.zh: 她的金发在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。

ex.en: Films that repeatedly associate blonde hair with particular personalities can reinforce unfair stereotypes about appearance.
ex.zh: 电影若反复将金发与特定性格联系起来，可能会强化对外貌的不公平刻板印象。

tip: blonde多用于女性；描述男性通常用blond。

senses.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
ex.zh: 她把一根黄瓜切成片，加入沙拉。

ex.en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
ex.zh: 在温室中种植黄瓜可以提供稳定的食物供应，但为这些设施供暖需要消耗能源。

tip: 通常可数：a cucumber；表示食材时也可不可数。

senses.en: Cooked using strong direct heat, often on a metal rack.

ex.en: We shared grilled vegetables and warm bread for lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐我们一起吃了烤蔬菜和热面包。

ex.en: Offering grilled fish alongside plant-based dishes can help school cafeterias provide a wider range of nutritious meals.
ex.zh: 学校食堂同时供应烤鱼和植物性菜肴，有助于提供更多种类的营养餐。

tip: grilled强调直接高温烤制；不表示“有格子的”。

senses.en: Let someone use something temporarily, expecting its return.
Give support or add a particular quality to something.

ex.en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
ex.zh: 你能把雨伞借给我用到明天吗？

ex.en: Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。

tip: lend是借出，borrow是借入；过去式为lent。

senses.en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see.
Deliberately unkind or hurtful towards another person.
Severe or painful, especially describing an illness or injury.

ex.en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。

ex.en: Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的恶意评论可能使年轻人不愿参与原本有价值的网络讨论。

tip: 比bad更带厌恶感；形容人时通常指刻薄、不友善。

senses.en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow
an oral medicine used to prevent pregnancy

ex.en: He swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
ex.zh: 他用一杯水把药片吞了下去。

ex.en: Although a pill may relieve symptoms, lasting improvements in health often require changes to daily habits.
ex.zh: 虽然药物可能缓解症状，但要持久改善健康，往往需要改变日常习惯。

tip: take a pill指服药；the pill常特指口服避孕药。

senses.en: An outdoor area where children play, often with special equipment.

ex.en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，孩子们跑向了游乐场。

ex.en: Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.
ex.zh: 每个社区都应提供安全的儿童游乐场，让孩子锻炼身体并培养社交能力。

tip: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

senses.en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity

ex.en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
ex.zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。

ex.en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
ex.zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

tip: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
ex.zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。

ex.en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
ex.zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。

tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

senses.en: A cosmetic applied to lips to give them colour.

ex.en: She put on red lipstick before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前涂了红色口红。

ex.en: Cosmetics companies are developing refillable lipstick containers to reduce packaging waste and respond to environmental concerns.
ex.zh: 化妆品公司正在开发可替换内芯的口红管，以减少包装废弃物并回应环保关切。

tip: 物质义不可数；一管口红用a tube of lipstick。

senses.en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
a show broadcast on television or radio
to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
ex.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

ex.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
ex.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。
